label: Alchemist's outfit
title: Alchemist's outfit
lead:
The alchemist's outfit is an equipment set that is obtained as a reward from the Mastering Mixology activity. It is made up of the prescription goggles, alchemist labcoat, alchemist pants, and alchemist gloves.

When worn, the prescription goggles will give a 10% chance to save a secondary ingredient when mixing potions. Only the goggles have a beneficial effect; the rest of the outfit is purely cosmetic.

label: ale
title: ale
lead: Ales are a category of brewed drinks, usually obtained from bars, pubs and inns across the world or brewed by players themselves. Most ales restore a little health, but also provide a few temporary boosts to skills, while they also have a drawback on others, usually Attack, Strength, and Defence, which should be considered before they are drunk.

label: Alfi Marino
title: Alfi Marino
lead: Alfi Marino was a resident of Varrock in the Year 160 of the Fifth Age mentioned in the Varrock Census. According to the Census, Alfi was a chef.

label: Alfonse the waiter
title: Alfonse the waiter
lead: Alfonse the waiter runs The Shrimp and Parrot in Brimhaven which sells food. He is a member of the Phoenix Gang and will help the player during the Heroes' Quest if they are in the gang. He also sells fish including cooked karambwan. Alfonse is quite well-mannered. This is odd for a resident of Brimhaven, known for its population of pirates and thieves.

label: Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl
title: Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl
lead: Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl is a miniquest that is required to be completed in order to gain access to the Horror from the Deep and Scorpion Catcher quests, and access to the Barbarian Outpost Agility Course, where it is considered a "rite of passage". To complete it, you must trek around various bars and pubs in Old School RuneScape, drinking a specialty drink, having them sign off a supplied Barcrawl card. The miniquest is notable for granting the ability to automatically smash vials on drinking the last dose of a potion.

label: Alfredo Fideu
title: Alfredo Fideu
lead: Alfredo Fideu is a penguin and the leader of the Fettuccine Mafia. A native of the Motherland, Alfredo is the brother of Noodle, another Fettuccine Mafia member currently operating on the Iceberg.

label: All Stars: PvP Championship
title: All Stars: PvP Championship
lead:
The All Stars: PvP Championship was an invite-only in-person PvP tournament that took place on 24 November 2018. It was streamed live on the official Old School RuneScape Twitch channel starting at 05:00 UTC and ran for around 9 hours.

Following up from the 2017 PvP Championship the prior year, it featured 16 creators who competed for their share of $30,000 and a trophy. The winner of the tournament was Manked, beating DitterBitter 4-0 and winning every single match he played.

label: All Stars: PvP Championship Beta
title: All Stars: PvP Championship Beta
lead:

 in Kourend Castle.]]
In celebration of the upcoming All Stars: PvP Championship, four public unrestricted worlds have been added, with four other unrestricted worlds reserved for the competition's participants to privately practice in. Like the Raids Rewards beta, this iteration of the unrestricted world is also open world. However, a few new features have been added to the unrestricted world in addition to what's already available.

Periodically, bosses will spawn in one of five locations (Falador Park/Castle, Al Kharid, Burthorpe, Barbarian Village and Kourend Castle) and is broadcasted in the player's chatbox. Players can access these locations through the hub portal just west of the bank, but are recommended to take a ring of dueling from the supplies table before leaving in order to quickly return. In addition, Ancient Warriors' equipment, which is normally exclusive to seasonal deadman mode worlds, is made available to all players.

label: allotment patch
title: allotment patch
lead:
Allotments are farming patches that players can grow vegetables and fruits in with the Farming skill. Most allotment patches also have a compost bin, a tool leprechaun, a herb patch, and a flower patch very near by. Particularly at high Farming levels and with the use of high tiers of compost and magic secateurs, allotments yields can be exceptionally high.

Three allotment seeds are needed to plant in each allotment patch, though equipping an amulet of bounty gives a chance to consume only one. Allotments are the 2nd fastest growing type of crop, with a 10 minute farming cycle. Players can protect their allotments from disease by paying nearby farmers with the appropriate payment for each separate patch, or through having the corresponding flower fully grown in the nearby patch; flowers that protect allotments are specific to the seed planted, though the white lily protects all crop types in an allotment patch.

label: Almera
title: Almera
lead:
Almera is located in a house south of the Barbarian Outpost, at the Baxtorian Falls. She is the starting point for the Waterfall Quest and has a son named Hudon.

She will send the player to check on her son, who is looking for treasure in the river behind the house.

label: Alomone
title: Alomone
lead:
Alomone is the leader of the Cult of Hazeel, a group dedicated to the revival of the Zamorakian mahjarrat Hazeel.

The cult stole a set of armour from Ceril Carnillean then broke in four more times in search of the scroll required to revive Hazeel, but failed each time. In Hazeel Cult, Ceril commissions the player to retrieve the armour, pointing them to the cult's lair in the sewers.

label: Alone
title: Alone
lead:
Alone is a music track unlocked at Ice Mountain, or in the Clock Tower dungeon.

In Classic mode, the track plays in a wider area around the Ice Mountain, as well as the Edgeville Monastery, as described in the first map with obvious square-like borders (not the next one) in case its caption is not visible.

label: Alrena
title: Alrena
lead:
Alrena is a citizen of East Ardougne, the wife of Edmond, and the mother of Elena. She lives north of the Flying Horse Inn.

She plays a part in the Plague City quest, helping the player attempt to locate Elena, and offering the player the gas mask if they bring her dwellberries. If the player has lost the gas mask, it can be retrieved in the cupboard.

label: altar
title: altar
lead:
.]]
An altar is an interactive piece of scenery which allows a player to recharge their Prayer points. To pray at an altar, you must left click on the altar, or right click and select the Pray or Pray-at option. Your character will kneel by the altar and your prayer points will be recharged. To locate an altar, look for the altar icon ( ) on the World map or Minimap. A player will receive the message, "You fear the wrath of the gods!" if the player uses an object on an altar that does not create an interaction, similarly to the message, "Nothing interesting happens."

label: Altar (disambiguation)
title: Altar (disambiguation)
lead: Altar may refer to:

label: Altar (Edgeville Monastery)
title: Altar (Edgeville Monastery)
lead: The Altar in the Edgeville Monastery is one of the many altars dedicated to Saradomin. Praying at this altar recharges prayer points, and gives 2 extra prayer points. A prayer level of 31 is required to reach the altar.

label: Altar (God Wars Dungeon)
title: Altar (God Wars Dungeon)
lead:
There are five altars in the God Wars Dungeon, near every general.

Each of these altars can recharge prayer points every 10 minutes, which also gives a +1 Prayer bonus for every piece of equipment affiliated to the correct deity. An exception to this is the Zarosian altar, where it will also restore players hitpoints, special attack, and run energy as long as at least one Zaros affiliated item is worn. Furthermore, every altar has the option to teleport players outside of the general's lair.

label: Altar (Saradomin)
title: Altar (Saradomin)
lead: An Altar dedicated to Saradomin can be found in many places across Gielinor. These altars can all be used to recharge prayer points.

label: Altar (The Restless Ghost)
title: Altar (The Restless Ghost)
lead:
The Altar in the Wizards' Tower basement is searched during The Restless Ghost quest.

When players have progressed far enough in the quest, searching the altar will give a Ghost's skull and awaken a level 13 skeleton. Otherwise, searching it will give the message "That skull looks scary. I've got no reason to take it, I think I'll leave it alone."

label: Altar of Guthix
title: Altar of Guthix
lead:
The Altar of Guthix is the centerpiece of the stone circle at Taverley. As this is the last surviving circle under Guthixian control, it is incredibly important to the druidic order. The altar is overseen primarily by Kaqemeex, an important druid within Taverley.

Every year during the summer, the druids get together to perform a ritual to Guthix, which helps maintain balance and protect nature from evil, corrupting spirits. This involves making offerings to the altar, which the player could help complete the ritual by figuring out the correct offering during the 2014, 2015, 2016, and 2017 Midsummer events.

label: Altar of nature
title: Altar of nature
lead:
The Altar of nature in the Nature Grotto is repaired during the Nature Spirit quest. Praying at the altar restores prayer points, and gives 2 extra points.

During the quest, an adventurer helps Filliman in becoming a Nature Spirit. The spirit then heals the grotto.

label: altar slab
title: altar slab
lead: The altar slab can be found in south-east Varrock next to the Chaos Altar there, as well as in the chaos druids' alcove and near the monks of Zamorak in the Taverley Dungeon. Using any item on the altar slab gives the message "You don't want to think about what's been on there!"

label: Altar/Locations
title: Altar/Locations
lead:
This list only lists non-construction altars which can be used to recharge prayer points

label: Aluft Gianne
title: Aluft Gianne
lead:
Aluft Gianne was the original owner of the Gnome Restaurant business in the Tree Gnome Stronghold. He offered a small tutorial on Gnome cooking, which allowed players to make gnome food, and sold premade versions of the food in Gianne's Restaurant. Afterwards, he would hire the player to cook specific foods for him, offering Coins and Cooking experience as a reward.

In 2006 the Gnome Restaurant was improved and expanded, changing the way in which the food is prepared and having the deliveries be made to clients instead. Aluft Gianne was split into two new characters, Aluft Gianne snr. and Gianne jnr. As a result, he has never been present in Old School RuneScape, although the character of Aluft Gianne snr. is very similar.

label: Ambassador
title: Ambassador
lead:
Ambassador may refer to:

*Ambassador Alvijar, a dwarven emissary in Dorgesh-Kaan
*Ambassador Ferrnook, a gnomish emissary in Varrock
*Ambassador Gimblewap, a gnomish emissary in East Ardougne
*Ambassador Spanfipple, a gnomish emissary in Falador

label: Ambience 2
title: Ambience 2
lead:
"Ambience 2" was the filename of an unused music track that could be previously found in the cache. It was added in the Runescape 2 beta, but it is unknown where it was intended to play. It was removed from the game files on 26 September 2019.

The track has a copyright date of 2003 rather than the usual 2003-04, as it was not updated when the Music Player was released.

label: Ambience 3
title: Ambience 3
lead:
"Ambience 3" was the filename of an unused music track that could be previously found in the cache. It was added in the Runescape 2 beta, but it is unknown where it was intended to play. It was removed from the game files on 26 September 2019.

The track has a copyright date of 2003 rather than the usual 2003-04, as it was not updated when the Music Player was released.

label: Ambience 4
title: Ambience 4
lead:
"Ambience 4" was the filename of an unused music track that could be previously found in the cache. The track is a shorter version of Fade Test. It was added in the Runescape 2 beta, but it is unknown where it was intended to play. It was removed from the game files on 26 September 2019.

The track has a copyright date of 2003 rather than the usual 2003-04, as it was not updated when the Music Player was released.

label: Ambient Jungle
title: Ambient Jungle
lead:
Ambient Jungle is a music track that is unlocked inside Shilo Village. It also plays in the underground area of the Shilo Village mine. Interestingly, although the 2024 update to its unlock area reduced the amount of area outside of the village walls, there are still some individual tiles where the track can be unlocked outside of the village gates. One such place is the southern banks of the river, on the western side of the village.

In Classic mode, a section of area outside the border of Shilo Village also plays this track.

label: Amblor
title: Amblor
lead:
Amblor is a vampyre and one of the possible senders of a message to the player if they successfully complete the Theatre of Blood. Amblor is not particularly interested in the Theatre, and is only there because his wife Mervilla wants to read her books in peace.

They are only mentioned in the message, and cannot be found anywhere in-game.

label: Amlodd Clan
title: Amlodd Clan
lead:
The Amlodd Clan is one of the eight elven clans who were originally brought to Gielinor from Tarddiad by Guthix and Seren in the early First Age. They are a clan of mystics, shamans and mages. They are located north-west of the Tower of Voices in Prifddinas, off the western path.

The Gauntlet was created by the Amlodd Clan to help train Prifddinas' finest warriors and survivalists. The Amlodd Clan also created the enhanced crystal teleport seed.

label: Ammo mould
title: Ammo mould
lead:
An ammo mould is a quest item used in Dwarf Cannon. It is obtained from Nulodion after speaking to Captain Lawgof after repairing his broken dwarf multicannon. Additional moulds can be purchased from Nulodion's Multicannon parts for sale store for .

It is given to Captain Lawgof alongside Nulodion's notes to complete the quest. It is also used to smith cannonballs with metal bars at a furnace to make 4 cannonballs per bar.

label: ammonium nitrate
title: ammonium nitrate
lead:
Ammonium nitrate is a quest item. It is used in The Dig Site quest along with nitroglycerin, ground charcoal, and arcenia root to make a chemical compound.

It is obtained by using the chest key to open the chest near the panning point, and is brought to Terry Balando, who identifies it as ammonium nitrate. Before he identifies it, it is known as chemical powder.

label: ammunition
title: ammunition
lead:
Ammunition is worn equipment primarily in the ammunition slot that is usually consumed by Ranged weapons. Bows use arrows, crossbows use bolts, ballistae use javelins, and the toxic blowpipe uses darts. The level required on the tables below is equivalent to the weapon requirement to use that ammunition, e.g., mithril arrows can only be used with willow bows and higher, requiring a minimum of 20 Ranged.

Ammunition is also one of the main products of the Fletching skill, the other being ranged weapons themselves.

label: Ammunition slot table
title: Ammunition slot table
lead: Click a column header icon to sort the table by that column. Use SHIFT click to sort by multiple columns.

label: Amon Ducot
title: Amon Ducot
lead:
Amon Ducot is the author of The Theory of Transvergence and Transportation incantations, two books found in the Grand Library of Kourend in Arceuus.

In Transvergence theory, Amon studies the art of runecraft and the differences in practice between Great Kourend and the mainland. He notes the strange properties of the Dark Altar, and its apparent self preservation.

label: Amoxliatl/Strategies
title: Amoxliatl/Strategies
lead: After completion of The Heart of Darkness, players can fight Amoxliatl as a regular boss encounter within the Ruins of Tapoyauik, albeit slightly stronger than when fought during the quest.

label: amulet
title: amulet
lead:
:For all items and their stats worn in this slot, see this table.

An amulet is a piece of jewellery in Old School RuneScape worn in the neck slot of the Worn Equipment tab. Using the Crafting skill, players can create an amulet by adding a ball of wool to an unstrung amulet. Most amulets can be enchanted using Magic, adding various unique bonuses or effects. Unenchanted amulets are purely cosmetic.

label: Amulet mould
title: Amulet mould
lead: An amulet mould is used to create amulets through the Crafting skill. It can be obtained at the Crafting Guild and some crafting stores. It can also be obtained in your house if you have a tool store 4 in your workshop.

label: Amulet of accuracy
title: Amulet of accuracy
lead:
An amulet of accuracy is a reward from the Imp Catcher quest. To complete Imp Catcher, Wizard Mizgog trades an amulet of accuracy for a set of black, red, white, and yellow beads. After the quest it is possible to give him one of each bead again for another amulet.

The amulet is easily obtainable for new players because the quest has no requirements apart from killing imps; however, it is only recommended if the player is an Ironman lacking Magic levels to enchant better amulets. Amulet of power is already a straight upgrade across all stats.

label: Amulet of defence
title: Amulet of defence
lead:
The amulet of defence is created when an emerald amulet has been enchanted using the Lvl-2 Enchant spell. It is not widely used, as it only gives defence bonuses. However, it can prove useful in situations where more damage is going to be taken than dealt, such as skilling in the Wilderness or activities like Pyramid Plunder. For this purpose, for Members, the Gnome amulet can be a better option as it has nearly twice the melee defensive bonuses (but no ranged or magic defensive bonuses).

Amulets of defence can be sold to Davon's Amulet Store in Brimhaven, starting at 1,147 coins each if none are in stock. The amulet of defence (t), a cosmetic variant, can be obtained as a rare reward from beginner clue scrolls.

label: amulet of doomion
title: amulet of doomion
lead:
The amulet of doomion is an item used in the later stages of the Underground Pass quest. It is obtained by killing the level 91 demon Doomion. It is one of the three amulets used in the quest. The other two are obtained by killing Doomion's comrades, Holthion and Othanian. Players can use their amulets to open a chest that contains Iban's shadow.

After the quest, the amulets cannot be obtained and have no other use.

label: Amulet of glory
title: Amulet of glory
lead:
The amulet of glory is a dragonstone amulet that has been enchanted by the Lvl-5 Enchant spell. After completion of Heroes' Quest, it can be charged at the Fountain of Heroes and the Fountain of Rune. When charged at the Fountain of Rune they will have 6 charges instead of the normal 4. With the completion of Dragon Slayer II, it can be charged at the Fountain of Uhld below the Myths' Guild. The amulet of glory is tradeable on the Grand Exchange only when it has zero, four, or six charges.

It is a very popular amulet in members-only worlds amongst players of all levels, as it provides good damage bonuses, has no requirements to wear, is much less expensive than the amulet of fury, and offers useful teleports.

label: Amulet of Glory (interface item)
title: Amulet of Glory (interface item)
lead:
The Amulet of Glory is an interface item that can be seen in the Construction skill guide representing the Amulet of Glory.

The actual item cannot be obtained by players.

label: amulet of holthion
title: amulet of holthion
lead:
Amulet of holthion is an item obtained during the Underground Pass quest. After defeating Holthion, one of Iban's guardians, the player receives the amulet. In conjunction with the other two amulets from the other guardians, all the amulets open the chest containing Iban's shadow.

After the quest, the amulets cannot be obtained and have no other use.

label: Amulet of magic
title: Amulet of magic
lead:
An amulet of magic is an amulet that gives a Magic attack bonus when worn. It is created by casting Lvl-1 Enchant on a sapphire amulet. It is one of the cheapest and most common amulets in the game because of the low Crafting level to craft it, how common sapphires are, and the low Magic level to enchant the amulet.

A normal amulet of magic, as well as its trimmed variant are both possible reward for the completion of easy Treasure Trails.

label: Amulet of othanian
title: Amulet of othanian
lead:
The amulet of othanian is an item used in the later stages of the Underground Pass. It is obtained by killing the level 91 demon Othainian. Once Othainian and his comrades Holthion and Doomion have been killed, the player can use their amulets to open a chest that contains Iban's shadow.

After the quest, the amulets cannot be obtained and have no other use.

label: Amulet of power
title: Amulet of power
lead:
An amulet of power offers a good balance of attack and defence bonuses for all classes of combat. It is created by casting Lvl-4 Enchant on a diamond amulet, and has no requirements to be worn.

This item is a less expensive option for players who do not wish to buy an amulet of glory. It lacks the glory's teleportation capabilities and has weaker attack and Prayer bonuses, but has the same strength bonus as well as higher defence bonuses.

label: Amulet of strength
title: Amulet of strength
lead:
The Amulet of strength is an enchanted ruby amulet. Players frequently use it to increase their max hit. At level 50 Crafting, players can craft a ruby amulet. With at least 49 Magic, Lvl-3 Enchant can be cast on a ruby amulet to create an amulet of strength.

A trimmed version of the amulet of strength is available from medium clue scrolls.

label: An Existential Crisis
title: An Existential Crisis
lead: An Existential Crisis is an unfinished quest not accessible in the game. The quest would have been started by talking to Izel who is dealing with Hugh who is not looking great. The quest summary is "Assist a man having an existential crisis." The quest assets were added to the game on 23 July 2025 with the release of Varlamore: The Final Dawn which included four quests, and another unfinished quest, Impending Chaos.

label: an experimental anvil
title: an experimental anvil
lead: An experimental anvil is an anvil used during The Tourist Trap to smith prototype darts. It can only be used during the quest. The Bedabin Nomad Guard will stop you from entering the tent containing it otherwise.

label: Ana
title: Ana
lead:
Ana is a girl from Misthalin who likes exploring. Unfortunately, she likes it a little too much and has recently disappeared into the Kharidian Desert. The player meets her mother, Irena, at the beginning of the quest, 'The Tourist Trap', in which they must rescue Ana. After searching the desert and finding her scarf, the player will discover that she has been captured by the slavers of the Desert Mining Camp. After a series of trials and tricks, the player is able to smuggle her out of the camp by hiding her in a barrel, and thus reuniting Ana with her mother.

At the end of the quest, Irena will do the wave emote and say "Hi Ana!". Then, Ana will walk towards her and disappear. Though Ana disappears, Irena stays at the entrance of Shantay Pass, as though she is still waiting for her daughter.

label: Ana in a barrel
title: Ana in a barrel
lead: Ana in a barrel is the result of using a Barrel on Ana, which is used to smuggle her out of the mining camp she has been imprisoned in, and is a quest item used by the player during The Tourist Trap quest. If a player drops the barrel, Ana will climb out of it, and she will appear in the mines again. Players who attempt to teleport out while carrying her will drop the barrel first.

label: ancestral robes
title: ancestral robes
lead:
Ancestral robes can be obtained as rare drops from the Chambers of Xeric. Equipping the robes requires level 75 Magic and 65 Defence.

They are the best-in-slot robes for general magic use (i.e. powered staves and standard spellbook spells), as they possess the highest magic damage bonus and are tied with Virtus robes for the highest magic accuracy bonus. However, when casting Ancient Magicks, their magic damage bonus is surpassed by Virtus robes, making Ancestral inferior when barraging monsters. Ancestral robes do not degrade in combat.

label: Anchor
title: Anchor
lead:
Anchor may refer to:

* Barrelchest anchor, a weapon
* Anchor (scenery), common scenery
* Anchor (Mogre Camp), scenery found in the Mogre Camp

label: Anchovies
title: Anchovies
lead:
Anchovies are a type of fish that restores 1 Hitpoint when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw anchovies on a fire or cooking range, granting 30 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in burnt anchovies. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. Anchovies are one of a number of foods with a reduced burn rate while using the Lumbridge Castle range with Cook's Assistant completed. It will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 34, or 31 when using the Lumbridge range.

Anchovies are an ingredient in anchovy pizzas, and are also used in the creation of impling jars.

label: Anchovy pizza
title: Anchovy pizza
lead:
Anchovy pizza is a type of pizza that restores 18 Hitpoints in total, 2 bites each healing for 9. It can be obtained by using anchovies on a plain pizza, requiring 55 Cooking and granting 39 experience.

Anchovy pizzas are the highest healing food per slot in free-to-play and are also a type of fast food.

label: Ancient
title: Ancient
lead:
The adjective ancient ' is often associated with the god Zaros. Items, non-player characters, locations, and objects that are related to Zaros are referred to as 'ancient', unlike items associated with other gods such as Saradomin, Guthix, and Zamorak. However, many things with the adjective are either unrelated, have no known association with Zaros, or are just supposed to be 'from ancient times'.

Ancient may refer to:

label: Ancient altar (interface item)
title: Ancient altar (interface item)
lead:
The Ancient altar is an interface item that can be seen in the Construction skill guide representing the Ancient altar.

The actual item cannot be obtained by players.

label: Ancient armour
title: Ancient armour
lead:
The Ancient armour set is a set of melee armour affiliated to the god Zaros. Pieces of the armour provide identical attack and defence stats as Rune armour, except for the kiteshield's ranged attack bonus being -2 (rather than -3), as well as each item having a +1 prayer bonus. Therefore, they require 40 Defence to be worn.

Each piece of the Ancient armour set can be obtained by completing hard Treasure Trails, and cannot be made via the Smithing skill.

label: Ancient artefacts
title: Ancient artefacts
lead:
Ancient artefacts are items dropped by revenants in the Revenant Caves. These can be exchanged for large quantities of coins by speaking to the Emblem Trader wandering around the caves or chiseled down into revenant ether.

Ancient artefacts cannot be protected upon death. Players will always lose artefacts if they are killed, even if they are the only item in the player's inventory.

label: Ancient blessed dragonhide armour
title: Ancient blessed dragonhide armour
lead:
The ancient blessed d'hide armour is a set of Ranged armour said to be blessed by Zaros. Every piece requires 70 Ranged and 40 Defence, except for the blessed chaps and blessed bracers, which do not have the Defence requirement. Blessed dragonhide has better defensive stats and the same offensive stats as the corresponding black dragonhide armour with an additional +1 Prayer bonus. Unlike normal dragonhide armour, a coif and boots are also available. Each piece of armour may be obtained as a reward from hard Treasure Trails.

Wearing any piece of ancient blessed dragonhide armour will make the Zarosian followers unaggressive in the Ancient Prison within the God Wars Dungeon.

label: Ancient ceremonial robes
title: Ancient ceremonial robes
lead:
Ancient ceremonial robes are a set of Prayer robes, with each individual piece dropped by all NPCs in the Ancient Prison, excluding Nex.

The robes set can be stored in a magic wardrobe within the costume room of a player-owned house.

label: Ancient gallows
title: Ancient gallows
lead: The Ancient gallows are located at the end of Ah Za Rhoon. During the Shilo Village quest, the gallows must be searched to obtain Zadimus corpse. After quest completion, looking-at or searching them will produce the chat message, "You notice nothing significant about this".

label: Ancient Gate
title: Ancient Gate
lead: The Ancient Gates are located in the Shaman Caves and must be opened to proceed through the caves during the Legends' Quest. The first gate features a complex locking mechanic and must be opened using a lockpick (note: a strange old lockpick will not work), requiring 50 Thieving. The second gate is heavily constructed, being made from cast-iron, 50 Strength is required to push it open. The third gate located in the room with the Carved rocks can only be opened by casting any Charge Orb spell on it while having an uncharged orb in the inventory, resulting in the player automatically jumping through it.

label: Ancient Gnomish
title: Ancient Gnomish
lead: Ancient Gnomish was the language spoken by the gnome race before they adopted the common tongue as a standard language. Only a small proportion of the language is known as it has been translated by Anita the gnome, Glough's girlfriend. Gnomish is no longer a widely spoken language and gnomes have mostly forgotten it, though the gnome glider service write their locations in Gnomish. The only known person to speak exclusively in Ancient Gnomish in the present day was Hazelmere. Players can learn a small proportion of the language by reading the translation book given by Anita.

label: Ancient key
title: Ancient key
lead:
Ancient key refers to one of the following items:
* Ancient key (Dragon Slayer II)
* Ancient key (Tombs of Amascut)

label: Ancient machinery
title: Ancient machinery
lead:
Ancient machinery can mean any of the following:

* Ancient machinery (Great Kourend)
* Ancient Machinery (old notes)

label: Ancient Magicks
title: Ancient Magicks
lead:
Ancient Magicks (also known as Ancients) are a series of Magic spells unlocked upon completion of the quest Desert Treasure I. Unlike the Lunar spellbook, which primarily focuses on utility spells, and both the standard spellbook and the Arceuus spellbook, which feature a mixture of combat and utility spells, the Ancient Magicks is significantly combat-oriented, including some of the most powerful combat spells in the game.

Having far fewer spells than the other spellbooks, the Ancient Magicks only contains 16 combat spells and 9 teleports. Ancient Magicks spells require multiples of expensive runes such as death and blood runes. Owing to their power (a minimum of 50 Magic is needed to even access the spellbook), Ancient Magick spells are popular in player-versus-player activities.

label: Ancient page (God page)
title: Ancient page (God page)
lead: Ancient pages are rewards from Treasure Trails. If a player has all four they can use them to make a book of darkness.

label: Ancient Prison
title: Ancient Prison
lead:
Ancient Prison may refer to:
* The Ancient Prison within the God Wars Dungeon, where Nex is located
* The Ancient Prison within Neypotzli, in front of the entrance to the Blood Moon's chamber
* Ghorrock Prison, a Zarosian prison where Duke Sucellus is sealed away

label: Ancient rings
title: Ancient rings
lead:
The Ancient rings are upgraded versions of the Fremennik rings that offer the highest attack and strength bonuses in various different combat stats. They are created by imbuing the icons of broken down Fremennik rings (obtained from the Dagannoth kings), with vestiges and bars dropped by the post-quest bosses of Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire. The vestiges are not tradeable, but the completed ancient rings are.

In order to wield the ring, the player must obtain at least one kill count from their respective boss, which is done during the quest. Attempting to wield them otherwise will result in the message The ring slips off your finger. The power within it seems unfamiliar.

label: Ancient shield
title: Ancient shield
lead:
Ancient shield may refer to:

*Ancient d'hide shield
*Ancient kiteshield
*Ancient wyvern shield

label: Ancient talisman
title: Ancient talisman
lead:
Ancient talisman is a quest item. It is obtained and used in The Dig Site quest. Once you have passed all exams, go to dig in level 3 site (requires trowel and specimen brush) and you will eventually find the ancient talisman. Bring it to archaeological expert Terry Balando to learn that it is actually a talisman of Zaros. The archaeology expert is impressed and will give you an invitation letter to enter winches.

Additionally, duplicates can only be obtained during this part of the quest. In order to obtain a duplicate it must be done via the drop-trick while excavating the level 3 dig site. The duplicates are not removed from one's inventory upon completing the quest's section.

label: Ancient Vestige
title: Ancient Vestige
lead: Ancient vestiges are untradeable drops from Duke Sucellus, The Leviathan, The Whisperer and Vardorvis. They are combined with their corresponding Fremennik ring icons to create the Ancient rings.

label: Ancient vestment set
title: Ancient vestment set
lead: The Ancient vestment set is a members item set of Prayer armour aligned with Zaros. The pieces are only obtainable by completing easy and medium Treasure Trails.

label: Ancient Warriors' equipment
title: Ancient Warriors' equipment
lead:
Ancient Warriors' Equipment are sets of ancient armour and weaponry previously used by the Ancient Warriors, meant for use in player-versus-player combat activities.

Multiple variants exist of each equipment set: two can be earned by participating in the Bounty Hunter minigame and can only be used within Daimon's Crater, Castle Wars, Clan Wars, Soul Wars, the TzHaar Fight Pit, and both the player-owned house and Clan Hall combat rings, while the third set is exclusive to Deadman Mode.

label: Ancient Wyvern/Strategies
title: Ancient Wyvern/Strategies
lead:
Note: All Fossil Island wyverns may be killed in this same fashion regardless. However, the lower-level spitting, talon and long-tailed wyverns require 66 Slayer.
Ancient Wyverns are the strongest species of Wyvern. They possess very high Defence, Attack, and Hitpoints, thus making them very powerful foes. Like other Wyverns, they require an elemental, mind, dragonfire ward, dragonfire, or ancient wyvern shield to be equipped in order to be slain, or the player will suffer devastating damage from their unique icy breath. The ancient wyvern shield is the only shield that will grant immunity against the freezing effect from a wyvern's icy breath.

Note that after Bone Voyage, a Slayer level of 82 is required in order to deal damage to Ancient Wyverns (not withstanding the effects of a poisoned weapon). Otherwise, eating a wild pie at 77 Slayer will do, though kills will be extremely long.

label: Andrew Gower
title: Andrew Gower
lead: Andrew Christopher Gower was the lead developer and co-founder of Jagex Ltd., a Java-based game distributor and creator. His most famous creation is the MMORPG RuneScape, created during his time at the University of Cambridge.

Anger may refer to:

**Anger battleaxe
**Anger mace
**Anger spear
**Anger sword
*The Angry emote.

lead:
Angler or anglers may refer to:

*Angler's outfit, the Fishing experience-boosting set obtainable from Fishing Trawler

**Angler hat

**Cooked anglerfish
**Burnt anglerfish
*Blighted anglerfish, a variant of anglerfish that can only be eaten while inside the Wilderness.
*Anglers' Retreat, an island in the Mythic Sea unlocked at 51 Sailing
*Angler's paint, a rare type of boat paint obtainable from Deep sea trawling

label: Angler's outfit
title: Angler's outfit
lead:
The angler's outfit is an experience-boosting clothing set that grants 2.5% additional experience from all Fishing activities when worn. Equipping any item in the set requires level 34 Fishing. Like all experience-boosting sets, bonus experience is not granted for random events, experience lamps, or experience tomes. Wearing the outfit from level 34 to 99 will save about 317,000 experience, increasing to 4,900,000 experience saved if going all the way to 200 million.

Outside of training, the set is necessary for a master clue step, a hard combat achievement, and for access to minnow fishing. The angler's outfit can be stored in the armour case space in a player-owned house and in the tackle box. It is lost upon death above level 20 Wilderness.

label: Angry
title: Angry
lead:
Angry is the fourth listed emote. Upon use the player puts one hand on their hips and waves their fist in the air showing their anger.

This emote is already unlocked upon making an account.

label: Anima Mundi
title: Anima Mundi
lead:
Anima Mundi is the life force of Gielinor. It has a strong connection to spirit trees and other flora of the world, and is most alluded to by gnomes. This connection appears to be reciprocal, as some types of vegetation are able to assert influence over the life force of the world. Anima is fed by life.

The Tasakaal took on the purpose of serving the balance between life and death to protect the anima of Gielinor. According to them, without life there is no anima, but because life can also destroy and endanger the anima, it must be kept under control.

label: Anima seed
title: Anima seed
lead:
Anima seeds are a type of untradeable seed received from defeating the Hespori in the Farming Guild, and can only be planted in the anima patch within the intermediate tier of the Farming Guild. There are three types of anima seeds, all of which require level 76 Farming to plant (can be boosted):

*Attas seed: increases the yield of farming patches.
*Iasor seed: decreases the chance of farming patches becoming diseased.
*Kronos seed: provides a chance for farming patches of the same type to skip a growth stage (e.g. all tree patches will skip a growth stage simultaneously).

label: Animal masks
title: Animal masks
lead: Masks are cosmetic headwear obtained from treasure trails, holiday events, and quests.

label: Animal skull (scenery)
title: Animal skull (scenery)
lead: Animal skulls can be found all over Gielinor, typically marking the outside of scary dungeons. They act as a scenery element representing an ominous warning, and serve no practical purpose.

label: Animated
title: Animated
lead:
Animated may refer to:

*Warriors' Guild Animated Armour:
**Animated Bronze Armour
**Animated Iron Armour
**Animated Steel Armour
**Animated Black Armour
**Animated Mithril Armour
**Animated Adamant Armour
**Animated Rune Armour

label: Animated Armour
title: Animated Armour
lead:
Animated armour can be created and fought in the Warriors' Guild by using a platebody, platelegs, and a full helm of the same type of metal on one of the magical animators. When brought to life, the armour shouts "I'm ALIVE!" and attacks the player that created it. When at low Hitpoints, the armour may try to run away from the player, and so it is advised to have run turned on during the fight. Sometimes the armour will run to an animator and become stuck. If this occurs, the armour will not fight you back, and will not run further. If the player kills the armour, they will usually get back the armour used to create it as well as a certain number of warrior guild tokens depending on the armour type. Sometimes the armour will "break" during combat, and the player will only receive some of the pieces back.

Players could easily use the magical animators or the fences around them to safespot animated armours.

label: Animation overrides
title: Animation overrides
lead: Animation overrides are animations that can be unlocked to alter a default animation.

label: Animation stall
title: Animation stall
lead:
An animation stall is an action that causes a player to be locked into an animation for a short duration. There are "partial stalls" and "full stalls". Partial stalls allow the player to perform actions and to move around independently. While the character appears to be standing still performing an action, the true tile of the player is on another space. Conversely, a full stall does not allow the player to move independently or perform actions. Hits are usually queued up on the player, and received only after the action is complete. An example of this is the skillcape emote. Although this is not always the case; teleportation magic stalls the player, but hits do not stack when the animation ends.

Partial stalls mean the player is graphically disjointed from where the game internally considers them to be. This is usually caused by some items active effects, certain weapons attack animations, or certain spells (e.g. Spellbook Swap, Ice Barrage, Vengeance). If in a partial stall, when the animation ends, the player will be seen rapidly moving towards their true tile, in a manner similar to that of .

label: Anita
title: Anita
lead:
Anita is a gnome who first appears in The Grand Tree quest. She and her boyfriend, Glough, both live in the Tree Gnome Stronghold, though they do not live together. Her home is in the north-west of the stronghold, just west of the swamp.

She plays a part in The Grand Tree, with players obtaining Glough's key from her. She's also the author of the translation book used to understand Hazelmere.

label: Ankou (disambiguation)
title: Ankou (disambiguation)
lead:
Ankou may refer to:

*Ankous, the popular slayer monster

label: Ankou outfit
title: Ankou outfit
lead:
The ankou outfit can be obtained as a master clue scroll reward from Treasure Trails. Wearing any of the pieces will make the worn piece seem transparent on the player, similar to an ankou. The outfit provides no stats and is therefore purely cosmetic.

This set's items can be stored in the mahogany treasure chest of a costume room.

label: Anna
title: Anna
lead:
Anna Sinclair is one of Lord Sinclair's children. She is a suspect during the Murder Mystery quest. She seems to be the most common culprit of the murder, but there is no doubt that all the children were involved.

According to the Gossip, she loves sewing and gardening. At one point of time she had a relationship with Stanford the gardener, but they broke up and she tried to get him fired by killing the flowers in the garden.

label: Anna's barrel
title: Anna's barrel
lead: Anna's barrel can be found inside the Sinclair Mansion in Anna's bedroom. During the Murder Mystery quest, the player must search the barrel to find her silver necklace.

label: Anna's print
title: Anna's print
lead: Anna's print is a quest item in the Murder Mystery quest. It is created by using flypaper on the silver necklace after dusting it with a pot of flour. If the prints match those of the unknown print, it will become a killer's print, meaning Anna is the killer.

label: Annakarl
title: Annakarl
lead:
Annakarl was one of Zaros' fortresses that was located in what is now the Wilderness. It was captured in the early Third Age by Saradominist forces, and likely destroyed during the God Wars by followers of Zamorak and Saradomin. Zilyana, an Icyene commander of the Saradominist forces, was likely injured during the battle in Annakarl, leading to the creation of Saradomin's tear.

The last known location of Lamistard, a Mahjarrat who betrayed Zaros, is also the former fortresses of Annakarl.

label: Annalise
title: Annalise
lead: Annalise is a character mentioned only on page 9 of My notes, a book of pages collected by the player during and after the Barbarian Training miniquest. Annalise was supposedly beloved by the author of the page, who got lost in the Ancient Cavern. The dying author hoped that whoever found their note would pass on regards to Annalise, if she was still alive.

label: Anniversary event
title: Anniversary event
lead: Anniversary events are birthday events that celebrate the time since the original release of on 4 January 2001. They usually mark milestone years.

label: Annual Asgarnia Gardening Conference
title: Annual Asgarnia Gardening Conference
lead:
The Annual Asgarnia Gardening Conference is an annual event hosted for farmers and gardeners. It includes activities such as talks by certain gardeners. Despite the name, the event has been heard of as far as Keldagrim, suggesting it has some magnitude.

The conference is only mentioned by Rind the gardener in his letter to Elstan.

label: Anti-dragon shield
title: Anti-dragon shield
lead:
The anti-dragon shield is an item given by Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle during the Dragon Slayer I quest. After the quest, the shield can be purchased from Oziach, or obtained from Duke Horacio for free. It is tradeable, but can only be equipped if the player has started Dragon Slayer I.

The anti-dragon shield mitigates the effects of dragonfire, reducing the maximum hit of most dragon-breath attacks by roughly ~80%. It also prevents Elvarg from severely draining the player's combat stats. The effects of antifire potion stack with the anti-dragon shield; using both provides full protection from standard dragonfire attacks.

label: Anti-dragon shield (interface item)
title: Anti-dragon shield (interface item)
lead:
The Anti-dragon shield is an interface item that can be seen in the Construction skill guide representing the Anti-dragon shield.

The actual item cannot be obtained by players.

label: antifire potion
title: antifire potion
lead:
An antifire potion provides slight immunity to a dragon's breath. When used in conjunction with an anti-dragon shield or dragonfire shield, a single dose will provide complete immunity against dragonfire for 6 minutes. It can be made by a player with 69 Herblore by mixing clean lantadyme and then dragon scale dust in a vial of water, which grants 157.5 Herblore experience. It may only be used after starting Dragon Slayer I. Additionally, it can be upgraded to either an extended or super antifire by adding lava scale shards with 84 Herblore or crushed superior dragon bones with 92 Herblore, respectively.

Players will get a warning in their chatbox when the potion is about to wear off after approximately 5 minutes, 45 seconds: " " Then they will get another message when it has worn off, approximately 6 minutes in total: " " This allows you to keep track of how long you have until you have to drink again.

label: antipoison
title: antipoison
lead:
An antipoison is a potion made by using unicorn horn dust on a marrentill potion (unf), requiring 5 Herblore, yielding an antipoison(3) and 37.5 Herblore experience. A dose of antipoison cures poison and provides immunity to poison for 90 seconds. Drinking two doses of antipoison will cure venom. The first dose will reduce the venom to poison and the second will remove the poison.

The next cheapest alternative, superantipoison, cures poison and provides immunity for 6 minutes.

label: Antique lamp
title: Antique lamp
lead:
Antique lamps are rewards from quests, achievement diaries and the Varrock Museum miniquest. Like regular lamps, these lamps grant a player experience in a chosen skill, and the skill chosen must usually be over a certain level which is unboostable.

Lamps that are not included in the three items kept on death will be kept inside your death's coffer, if not deleted.

label: Antique updates
title: Antique updates
lead: Antique updates are updates that Jagex has mentioned or previously posted, but have since been removed from the RuneScape site. Most of these updates are from the very early days.

label: Antisanta outfit
title: Antisanta outfit
lead:
The Antisanta outfit is a holiday reward received from completing a Christmas event from 2014 onwards. The costume gives no bonus to any stats. The appearance changes depending on gender.

If lost or destroyed, the outfit can be reclaimed from Diango in Draynor Village. In addition, all of the costume items may be stored in the costume room of a player-owned house.

Antler bolts are ranged ammunition for the hunters' sunlight crossbow. There are two types:
*Moonlight antler bolts

label: anvil
title: anvil
lead:
An anvil is used to smith items through the Smithing skill. An anvil can be used to smith items by click on an anvil or using a bar on it while the player has a hammer in their inventory or is wielding an Imcando hammer. Upon interaction, a selection screen will come up allowing the player to choose an item to make. Multiple players can use the same anvil simultaneously.

There are several anvils located around Gielinor which are identified with an anvil icon on the minimap and world map.

label: Ape Atoll Teleport
title: Ape Atoll Teleport
lead:
Ape Atoll Teleport can refer to one of two spells:

*Ape Atoll Teleport (standard), which teleports the player to the Temple of Marimbo.
*Ape Atoll Teleport (Arceuus), which teleports the player to the Ape Atoll Dungeon.

label: Apothecary
title: Apothecary
lead:
Ingald Belger the Apothecary runs the pharmacy and potion shop in south-west Varrock. He plays a part in certain quests, often making delicate potions and herbal products.

Free acne potions can be obtained from him about 50% of the time when talking to him.

label: Apple orchard
title: Apple orchard
lead:
An apple orchard can be found immediately south-east of the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Inside the orchard, players can find a Rotten Apple Pile. During Mourning's End Part I, players use a barrel on the pile to receive a barrel of rotten apples, and then use the resulting barrel on the nearby Apple Press to make an apple barrel.

The scout from The General's Shadow miniquest can also be found wandering just outside of the orchard, to the west.

label: Apple pie
title: Apple pie
lead:
Apple pie is a type of pie that restores 14 Hitpoints in total, 2 bites each healing for 7. A pie dish will remain after both bites are consumed. It can be obtained by baking an uncooked apple pie on a cooking range, requiring level 30 Cooking and granting 130 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in burnt pie. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases, and it will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 63. Alternatively, casting the Bake Pie spell from the lunar spellbook will always create a pie without burning it.

Apple pie is a possible task from Romily Weaklax in the Cooks' Guild. Three apple pies are given to the player when starting Nature Spirit.

lead: April Fools' events are short holiday events that commemorate April Fools' Day, which occurs on the 1st of April.

label: Apropos
title: Apropos
lead: Apropos was a female Dragon rider, who served Zaros near the end of the Second Age. However, when Zamorak betrayed Zaros, Apropos sided with Zamorak and the other rebels. She has been found deceased after following her betrayal at Carrallanger.

label: Arabian
title: Arabian
lead:
Arabian is a music track that is unlocked in Al Kharid, at the Al Kharid mine and the Giants' Plateau. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing this track, Al Kharid and Arabian 2.

In Classic mode, the track plays in several locations in northern Kharidian Desert:
*On the path to the Emir's Arena north of Al Kharid.
*At the Citharede Abbey.
*At the Uzer mine.

label: Arabian 2
title: Arabian 2
lead:
Arabian 2 is a music track that is unlocked in Al Kharid, at the Al Kharid mine and the Giants' Plateau. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing this track, Al Kharid and Arabian.

In Classic mode, the track plays at the Al Kharid mining site.

label: Arabian 3
title: Arabian 3
lead:
Arabian 3 is a music track unlocked in members parts of Kharidian Desert. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing this track, Desert Heat, Desert Voyage, The Desert, Egypt, Scarab, Sphinx and Sunburn.

In Classic mode, the track plays near the Kalphite Lair which is in the western part of the desert.

label: Arabique
title: Arabique
lead: Arabique is a music track that is unlocked near the Hellhounds in Taverley Dungeon.

label: Arastasia
title: Arastasia
lead: Arastasia is a character and probable historical figure mentioned in the book Wintertodt parable. A resident of Kourend, she was the daughter of an unnamed lord. Dentristus, a farm hand from her father's farm, loved her. During a harsh winter, the Wintertodt was drawn from the north devouring animals and crops, which caused Arastasia to weep at the fear and distress caused to her people. Dentristus vowed to defeat the Wintertodt, and in exchange the lord offered Arastasia's hand in marriage. However, this would never come to pass as Dentristus was defeated.

label: Araxxor/Strategies
title: Araxxor/Strategies
lead:
Araxxor is a level 92 Slayer boss found in the Morytania Spider Cave. In order to fight him, completion of Priest in Peril to access Morytania is required, as well as having been assigned an Araxyte or spider Slayer task.

If the player dies while fighting Araxxor, their grave will be placed outside the entrance to his lair, which follows normal death rules.

label: Araxyte (disambiguation)
title: Araxyte (disambiguation)
lead:
Araxyte may refer to:
*Araxyte, the level 92 slayer monster
** Araxyte (NPC), the unattackable variant
*Araxxor, the araxyte boss

title: Araxyte (interface item)
lead:
The Araxyte is an interface item that can be seen in the Slayer skill guide representing the Araxyte.

The actual item cannot be obtained by players.

label: Arcenia root
title: Arcenia root
lead: Arcenia root is a quest item used in the quest The Dig Site to make Chemical compound along with nitroglycerin, ammonium nitrate and ground charcoal to blow up bricks blocking the path below digsite. It is obtained from tunnels where players can only enter with the invitation letter. Entering the tunnels requires 10 Agility.

label: Arceuus robes
title: Arceuus robes
lead: Arceuus robes were a armour set, proposed alongside the Warding skill. They were a set of mage robes that would have required level 30 Magic, 15 Defence, and 20 Prayer to wear, as well as completion of The Ascent of Arceuus quest. In order to ward the robes, players required level 40 Warding, along with dark silk.

id: category:pages containing information from failed polls
label: Pages containing information from failed polls
Arceuus spellbook
title: Arceuus spellbook
lead:
The Arceuus spellbook is a spellbook that players can immediately access upon speaking to Tyss in Arceuus; with a focus on necromancy, prayer, demon-slaying, and augmenting combat. Like the standard spellbook, it has a variety of combat and utility spells at its disposal, unlike the Lunar spellbook, which is primarily focused on utility spells, and the Ancient Magicks, which is heavily combat-oriented. A larger set of combat and utility spells are accessible to players upon completion of A Kingdom Divided.

Players can only have one type of spellbook at a time. If the player chooses to access the Arceuus spellbook it will replace their current one. You can speak to Tyss to have it lifted at any time.

label: Arceuus Spellbook Beta
title: Arceuus Spellbook Beta
lead:
with demonbane spells and a zombie thrall.]]
Three beta worlds (401, 407, 412) were opened to test the new additions to the Arceuus spellbook. As the beta was intended to test the new spells against various scenarios, players were allowed complete access to the world, excluding the Inferno. Players were also provided with the usual amenities that come with unrestricted worlds, including unlimited run energy.

Upon logging in, players were equipped with a full set of best-in-slot magic equipment with 10,000 of each rune (excluding combination runes), in addition to a rune pouch (l) containing 10,000 blood, fire, and soul runes.

label: Arceuus/Historical
title: Arceuus/Historical
lead:
Earning the favour of the Arceuus can be done by assisting Arceuus residents with expanding their knowledge, mining dense essence blocks and using the Arceuus spellbook to reanimate creatures. Once earning 100% Arceuus favour, players are able to runecraft blood and soul runes at their respective altars if players have level 77 and 90 Runecraft respectively.

To progress in the Architectural Alliance miniquest, players must gain 100% Arceuus favour and speak to Arcis, who is found in the building slightly north-east of the bank.

label: Archer
title: Archer
lead:
Archer may refer to:
*A player who uses the Ranged combat class (also called a ranger)
*Archer (Lost City), from Lost City
*Archer (Burthorpe)
*Archer (Ardougne)
*Archer helm

**Archers ring (i)

*Archery target
*Maniacal monkey archer, from Monkey Madness II
*Monkey archer, from Monkey Madness I

label: Archer (Ardougne)
title: Archer (Ardougne)
lead: Archers are found in Ardougne, atop Ardougne Castle. They are not aggressive to players, but when attacked, will defend themselves with Ranged attacks that are fairly accurate and can hit up to 6.

label: Archer (Burthorpe)
title: Archer (Burthorpe)
lead:
Archers are level 42 guards for Burthorpe Castle in Burthorpe, and are members of the Imperial Guard.

They are not aggressive to players, but when attacked, will defend themselves with Ranged attacks that are fairly accurate and can hit up to 6. They are occasionally trained on by mid-level players looking for their Green d'hide chaps drop.

label: Archer (Lost City)
title: Archer (Lost City)
lead: The Archer is part of a band of adventurers searching for Zanaris. The archer and her three companions, a wizard, a monk, and a warrior, can be found in the north-west part of the Lumbridge Swamp, near the Draynor bank. She is a part of the Lost City quest.

label: Archery shops
title: Archery shops
lead: Archery shops are a type of store found in Old School RuneScape. The stores are represented by an icon. Archery shops sell items related to the Ranged skill. There are several Ranged-related stores located throughout Gielinor.

label: Archery target (interface item)
title: Archery target (interface item)
lead:
The Archery target is an interface item that can be seen in the Construction skill guide representing the Archery target.

The actual item cannot be obtained by players.

label: Archery ticket
title: Archery ticket
lead:
An archery ticket is the reward given for using the target range at the Ranging Guild. The quantity received varies from 0-100 tickets per 10 shots at the cost of 200 coins. They can be exchanged with the Ticket Merchant within the guild for prizes, most notably rune arrows and green d'hide bodies.

The archery ticket is one of the items that may be asked for during Mourning's End Part II.

label: Archmage Sedridor
title: Archmage Sedridor
lead: Archmage Sedridor is the head wizard and chief of research at the Wizards' Tower, which trains wizards in the magical arts. He can be found in his office in the basement of the tower. After completion of Rune Mysteries, players can use him among other wizards to teleport to the rune essence mine.

label: Ardignas family
title: Ardignas family
lead:
The Ardignas family is the current royal family of Kandarin. There have supposedly been five kings of the Ardignas bloodline (six as of Song of the Elves).

The dynasty is a fairly short one, beginning somewhere between 98 and 101 of the Fifth Age and continuing in the present day. The line was founded by either the Saradominist or the Zamorakian survivor of the Great Battle. The brothers of Tyras and Lathas ruled over the city of Ardougne in two parts, Tyras in the West, and Lathas in the East, until Tyras' assassination on an expedition to the west.

label: Ardougne
title: Ardougne
lead: Ardougne ( ) is the capital and largest city of the Kingdom of Kandarin. It is divided into East Ardougne and West Ardougne. West Ardougne is closed off to the general public because of a mysterious "plague" affecting the inhabitants, but you can slowly gain complete access by completing the first few quests of the Plague City quest line. It is also probably the best place to find thieves in all of Gielinor.

label: Ardougne Baker's Stall.
title: Ardougne Baker's Stall.
lead:
The Ardougne Baker's Stall is a store located on the east side of the East Ardougne market that sells bread, cake, chocolate slices, and chocolate bars. It is run by a baker. It requires 5 Thieving to steal from.

Stealing a cake from one of the bakery stalls is an easy Ardougne Diary task.

label: Ardougne Castle
title: Ardougne Castle
lead:
Ardougne Castle is a castle in East Ardougne near the border to West Ardougne. King Lathas, the current king of Kandarin, lives on the . Players can start the Underground Pass quest here. Aside from the king, many Paladins wander the area around it.

There is also a Black scimitar spawn in the upper level of the castle behind a door (requires a Thieving level of 61 to lockpick), and two chests requiring a Thieving level of 72 to open. Stealing from one of these chests is a requirement for completing the Hard Ardougne Diary, and can be assigned as a skill challenge by Sherlock for elite clue scrolls.

label: Ardougne Chimeras
title: Ardougne Chimeras
lead: The Ardougne Chimeras are a football team favoured by Zamorak, according to his response in the God letters.

label: Ardougne Fur Stall.
title: Ardougne Fur Stall.
lead:
The Ardougne Fur Stall is a Fur stall in the south-eastern part of the East Ardougne marketplace. It is run by the fur trader.

The stall sells bear fur and grey wolf fur. They will buy and sell polar kebbit fur, common kebbit fur, feldip weasel fur, desert devil fur, tatty larupia fur, larupia fur, tatty graahk fur, graahk fur, tatty kyatt fur and kyatt fur from the player stock, but do not normally carry them.

label: Ardougne Gem Stall.
title: Ardougne Gem Stall.
lead: The Ardougne Gem Stall is a gem shop in East Ardougne market run by the gem merchant.

label: Ardougne Market
title: Ardougne Market
lead:
Ardougne Market, also called Ardougne Marketplace or the Equal Trade Market, is the biggest stall marketplace on Gielinor. The Ardougne Teleport spell teleports the caster into the centre of Ardougne Market. With East Ardougne being very wealthy, the marketplace is very popular with thieves, with it often being called the hub of Thieving. It contains eight market stalls (six with availability to buy from) listed with information below. The owners of the stalls will not buy back their products for 30–60 minutes from the player if they steal from their stalls.

The market is cited to have originated from the aftermath of The Great Battle at the Outpost north of Ardougne, wherein one of the survivors established the marketplace to promote equality of trade among the people.

label: Ardougne Monastery
title: Ardougne Monastery
lead:
The Ardougne Monastery, or Kandarin Monastery, in the kingdom of Kandarin is a building located south of Ardougne Zoo and north of the Fight Arena. It is made up of two two-story towers (east and west) joined by a single-story foyer. It is dedicated to the god Saradomin. Players can teleport here an unlimited number of times using an Ardougne cloak.

The monastery is fairly close to a fairy ring ( ), which can be reached by running east, as well as the Khazard Battlefield spirit tree, which can be reached by running west, then north. The convenience of the Monastery's location makes the Ardougne cloak arguably the best easy Achievement Diary reward.

label: Ardougne church
title: Ardougne church
lead:
The Ardougne church is the church of Kandarin capital's city of Ardougne. It features multiple characters who appear in the Sheep Herder quest. Interestingly, despite being a Saradominist church, there is a Zarosian grave in front of the building.

Praying at the altar is an easy Ardougne Diary task.

label: Ardougne cloak
title: Ardougne cloak
lead:
Ardougne cloaks are rewards from the Ardougne Diary obtained by speaking to Two-pints in the Flying Horse Inn in East Ardougne. The different upgrades of Ardougne cloaks are:

*Ardougne cloak 1, from the easy tasks set
*Ardougne cloak 2, from the medium tasks set
*Ardougne cloak 3, from the hard tasks set
*Ardougne cloak 4, from the elite tasks set

label: Ardougne farm
title: Ardougne farm
lead:
The Ardougne farm, also known as the Ardy farm, is a large farm just north of Ardougne, known for offering a herb patch which can conveniently be teleported to with the Ardougne cloak 2 or above. The farm is surrounded by oak trees. A mysterious statue near the potato field is used during the Holy Grail quest to help players find the Fisher Realm.

Players can build an easy STASH unit on the top floor of the farm's windmill.

label: Ardougne knight armour
title: Ardougne knight armour
lead:
The Ardougne knight armour is a set of armour that is made during the Song of the Elves quest. The defensive bonuses these items are equivalent to iron equipment, despite the set requiring a steel full helm, steel platebody, and steel platelegs to create. However, it can be equipped even at level 1 Defence.

This set can be stored in the armour case of a costume room. Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored. Ardougne knight platelegs cannot be reobtained if lost, so steel platelegs can also be substituted for them in the armour case.

label: Ardougne mine
title: Ardougne mine
lead:
Ardougne mine may refer to:

* South-east Ardougne mine
* Legends' Guild mine

label: Ardougne north bank
title: Ardougne north bank
lead:
The Ardougne north bank, also known as Ardy north, is the second bank of Ardougne. Among buildings dedicated exclusively for use as a bank, the internal area of the Ardougne north bank's is one of the smallest.

There is a Deadman chest in the bank.

label: Ardougne Revolution
title: Ardougne Revolution
lead:
The Ardougne Revolution was an uprising during Song of the Elves which led to the liberation of West Ardougne and the end of the treacherous King Lathas' reign over Kandarin. Prior to the revolution, West Ardougne was under the control of elves from the Iorwerth Clan. This was due to an agreement made by the leader of the Clan, Lord Iorwerth and the king of Kandarin, King Lathas in which Iorwerth agreed to help King Lathas defeat his brother, King Tyras - a popular claimant to the Kandarin throne.

In return for this, King Lathas granted Lord Iorwerth control of West Ardougne. To establish control over the city, the Iorwerth spread rumours of a false plague in the city. They then falsely posed as Mourners who would take people from their homes to help them. In reality, the plague victims were taken underground to a large underground tunnel where they were slaves for the Iorwerth. The slaves dug for ores, though the primary objective of the Iorwerth was to access the Temple of Light, which contained massive death energy that could summon the "Dark Lord". Unfortunately for the Iorwerth, an adventurer (who helped them, then changed sides after being told the truth), managed to enter the Temple of Light and activated its safeguards, supposedly preventing the Iorwerth from entering the Temple of Light for the next thousand years. However, the Temple of Light was not completely secure, as some dwarves were able to tunnel into the back of the temple.

label: Ardougne Sewers
title: Ardougne Sewers
lead: The Ardougne Sewers are an extensive dungeon system underneath East Ardougne and part of West Ardougne. Currently, players have access to three separate sections of the sewers, which are visited during various quests.

label: Ardougne Sewers mine
title: Ardougne Sewers mine
lead:
The Ardougne Sewers mine is a mine that features five iron and coal rocks. It is located below Ardougne in the Ardougne Sewers.

The iron ore is roughly 130 tiles away from the bank.

label: Ardougne Silver Stall.
title: Ardougne Silver Stall.
lead: Ardougne Silver Stall is a silver stall located in the East Ardougne Marketplace. It is run by the silver merchant.

label: Ardougne South Bank
title: Ardougne South Bank
lead:
The Ardougne south bank, also known as Ardy south or often simply Ardy bank, is the first of two banks added to the city of Ardougne.

The bank has three floors, although the and are trivial, due to being small 3x3 rooms with no features.

label: Ardougne Spice Stall.
title: Ardougne Spice Stall.
lead: The Ardougne Spice Stall is a spice stall in East Ardougne that sells knives, spices, and garlic. It is run by the spice seller.

label: Ardougne teleport
title: Ardougne teleport
lead: Ardougne Teleport teleports the caster to East Ardougne market. This spell can only be cast after reading the Ardougne teleport scroll, which is a quest completion reward from the Plague City quest. Once the player reads the scroll they will memorise the spell Ardougne Teleport and the scroll will crumble to dust. If a player loses this scroll, they can go back to Edmond in north-west of East Ardougne to get a new one. Casting the spell is a requirement for the Medium Ardougne Diary.

label: Ardougne teleport scroll
title: Ardougne teleport scroll
lead:
The Ardougne teleport scroll is a quest item reward in Plague City. It is obtained from Edmond after completion of the quest.

When read, players will be able to cast Ardougne Teleport spell (requiring level 51 Magic), although reading the scroll itself does not have a magic level requirement. Players do not need to read the scroll to use the Ardougne teleport tablet.

label: Ardougne Zoo
title: Ardougne Zoo
lead: The Ardougne Zoo, located in the southern part of East Ardougne, holds a variety of creatures gathered from across Gielinor. It is currently the only zoo in Old School RuneScape, and is involved in a handful of quests. The Ardougne Zoo is the only place outside of Ape Atoll where the player can use a monkey greegree.

label: Ardrigal
title: Ardrigal
lead:
Ardrigal is the clean form of grimy ardrigal, a herb obtained by searching the palm trees with large leaves on the north-eastern peninsula of Karamja, on the south side of the tree grapple shortcut. It is the second herb Trufitus asks the player to bring him during Jungle Potion, and is also used during Legends' Quest in combination with snake weed to make a bravery potion.

Trufitus will buy clean ardrigals for a random amount of coins between and . This can only be done by using the herb on him, as there is no dialogue option for selling them to him. He will not buy grimy ardrigals, his reasoning being that he cannot identify what the herb is.

label: Ardrigal mixture
title: Ardrigal mixture
lead: The ardrigal mixture is an item used during Legends' Quest to make a bravery potion. It is made by using an ardrigal on a vial of water. Snake weed can then be added to make the bravery potion, which is used to enter the dark cave during the quest. It can be made after completion of Legends' Quest, although it has no use.

label: Area effects
title: Area effects
lead:
Area effects are game mechanics confined to certain areas of Gielinor. The effects either deal damage to a player, or lower their stats.

Some area effects are based on a game chunk, a 64x64 set of game squares. As such, players can often find out where they are safe by looking at chunks on the World Map. Some area effects can also be stalled by opening interfaces. Some effects that run on timers can also be avoided by simply logging out before the timer reaches 0.

lead:
Arena may refer to:

*Emir's Arena

*Mage Training Arena
*Resource Arena
