label: Two-handed sword
title: Two-handed sword
lead:
Two-handed swords or 2h swords are a category of two-handed melee weapons. Weapons in this category generally have a slow attack speed but high attack and strength bonuses to compensate. The rune 2h sword's potential for high damage in a single attack makes its use common in player killing on free-to-play worlds as a finishing weapon.

Two-handed swords offer slash and crush attack styles. Players should choose the primary slash against most opponents, and the secondary crush against opponents wearing plate armour, such as platebody and platelegs. (Interestingly, the 3rd age longsword also uses this same set of attack styles despite being referred to as a slash sword in its combat options, being the only weapon in the game to use a different set of combat options to its category.)

label: Typeless
title: Typeless
lead:
Typeless is a classification to describe attacks whose damage is not negated by protection prayers. Generally, this damage still rolls accuracy against the corresponding defensive stats. Most typeless attacks are used by monsters, though there are some that can be used by the player (ex. the delayed magic attack from the ancient godsword's special attack, as well as the dragonfire discharged from a dragonfire shield).

The following monsters are known to use typeless attacks.

The TzHaar ( ) are a race of golem-like creatures that inhabit Mor Ul Rek, a lava-filled region beneath Karamja Volcano. The word "TzHaar" means "holy (sacred) fire". The TzHaar society is unlike any other, and only vaguely resembles any that exists on the surface.

Despite their fearsome appearance, the TzHaar are a peaceful race, and have existed beneath the surface of Karamja for thousands of years. Even today, the finer aspects of their society remain a point of great mystery amongst scholars.

label: TzHaar Fight Cave/Rotations
title: TzHaar Fight Cave/Rotations
lead:
In order to complete the TzHaar Fight Caves in a more predictable or efficient manner, one can predict the spawn location of future waves. There are only 15 possible rotations that describe the spawn locations of the monsters. The rotation may be predicted based on two different techniques:
* By checking which monsters spawn in the first two waves, the rotation can be determined in all but two rotations (which require 4 waves to make the distinction). For example, if in Wave 1, the first monster spawns centre, and then on Wave 2, the two monsters spawn in the north-west and south-west corner, the Rotation 1 will be in effect.
* The rotation is determined by the exact time when the player enters the caves. The rotation that the player will do changes exactly at every minute, except for Rotation 4, which lasts for two minutes before changing.

TzTok-Jad will always spawn at the same location as the monster that spawns in Wave 3.

label: TzHaar Fight Cave/Strategies
title: TzHaar Fight Cave/Strategies
lead:
If the player clicks log out while in the cave, they will not be logged out immediately. Instead, the wave following the current wave will be prevented from spawning, giving the player the opportunity to log out without loss of progress. Clicking the log out button a second time will log the player out immediately, but the current wave will have to be repeated.

It is generally recommended for the player to use Ranged for most of the run, as it allows the player to safespot monsters and attack them from a distance. At the highest levels and gear, using melee can be faster than Ranged, though the player is likely to take additional damage from melee attacks. Using Magic with Water Wave or Water Surge works well due to TzHaars' 40% weakness to water spells; however it is generally slower and more expensive than ranged. Blood spells, Vengeance, and Thralls can be used to support the other combat styles instead of using magic as primary damage.

The actual item cannot be obtained by players.

title: Tzrek

Tzrek may refer to:

label: Ugthanki
title: Ugthanki
lead:
Ugthanki are camels found in the Kharidian Desert, south of Shantay Pass. Ugthanki are the only creatures that drop ugthanki meat, which is used to make ugthanki kebabs.

They are aggressive, so players with low Hitpoints should keep away from them.

label: Ugthanki & onion
title: Ugthanki & onion
lead:
Ugthanki & onion is an intermediate product towards making an ugthanki kebab. It is made by chopping an onion and a piece of cooked Ugthanki meat into a bowl with a knife.

If players add a tomato, this makes kebab mix, which allows players to make an Ugthanki kebab if some pitta bread is added. The pitta bread requires level 58 Cooking, but the rest can be made at level 1.

label: Ugthanki & tomato
title: Ugthanki & tomato
lead:
Ugthanki & tomato is an intermediate product towards making an ugthanki kebab. It is made by chopping a tomato and a piece of cooked Ugthanki meat into a bowl with a knife.

If players add an onion to make kebab mix, they can make an Ugthanki kebab if some pitta bread is added. The pitta bread requires level 58 Cooking, but the rest can be made at level 1.

label: ugthanki kebab
title: ugthanki kebab
lead:
The ugthanki kebab is a type of food which restores 19 Hitpoints. It can be obtained by chopping a tomato, an onion, and a piece of cooked ugthanki meat into a bowl with a knife, then using the resulting kebab mix with a baked pitta bread. Level 58 Cooking is required to make the pitta bread, but the rest may be made at Cooking level 1. There is a chance to fail when creating one with a low Cooking level, instead creating a Ugthanki kebab (bad).

The player will exclaim in contentment if any hitpoints were restored when eaten.

label: Ugthanki kebab (bad)
title: Ugthanki kebab (bad)
lead: A strange-smelling ugthanki kebab is sometimes the result of attempting to make a regular ugthanki kebab with a low Cooking level, similar to how burning food works. It will usually heal nothing when eaten, but sometimes heals for 9. Despite its strange smell, it can still be combined with red hot sauce to create a regular super kebab.

label: Ugthanki meat
title: Ugthanki meat
lead:
Ugthanki meat is a type of food that restores 3 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking raw ugthanki meat, granting 40 experience when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in burnt meat. The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. Ugthanki meat is unusual as despite lacking a cooking requirement, it never stops burning altogether even at level 99. At levels up to 82, the chance to burn this meat is higher on a range than on a fire.

Ugthanki meat is used to make ugthanki kebab which restores 19 hitpoints.

label: Uhld
title: Uhld
lead: Uhld is the leader of the Sect of Uhld and the ancestor of Erdan. They founded the Myths' Guild with the rest of the Sect after witnessing the destruction of the entrance to the Wrath Altar, which had been rediscovered as a result of the wrath that the Fremennik crusaders, the Gunnites, had wrought upon the runic temples of the world. Their main goal is to preserve information.

label: Ulizius
title: Ulizius
lead:
Ulizius is a monk who guards the gate into Mort Myre Swamp. You need to start the Nature Spirit for him to let you through the gate into the swamp. When players return through the gate he will exclaim .

It is not known why Drezel or whoever Ulizius reports to would want to guard the entrance to the Mort Myre swamp nor why they would send such a poorly armed and nervous individual to do so. He seems to simply be there to warn players of the dangers of Mort Myre.

label: Ultimate
title: Ultimate
lead:
Ultimate may refer to:

* Ultimate force, a power-up in Nightmare Zone
* Ultimate Strength, a prayer unlocked at 31 Prayer
* Ultimate ironman, an account-type under Ironman mode
** Ultimate Ironman Guide, an in-depth guide to the ultimate ironman mode
* Ultimate ironman armour:
** Ultimate ironman helm
** Ultimate ironman platebody
** Ultimate ironman platelegs

label: Ultimate ironman armour
title: Ultimate ironman armour
lead:
The Ultimate ironman armour is a set of armour obtainable only by players who chose to be an Ultimate ironman in Ironman Mode. It is obtained by speaking to Adam after leaving Tutorial Island, after choosing to be an Ultimate ironman. Players may obtain a new set by speaking to him if they lose their set.

The armour pieces share their stats with the iron full helm, platebody and platelegs.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide
lead:
Playing as an Ultimate Ironman is full of unique and interesting challenges, and it is very different from a regular account or normal Ironman. In addition to the restrictions given to regular Ironman, Ultimate Ironmen cannot use banks. This guide aims to give general advice, tips, and suggestions for playing as an Ultimate Ironman.

This page has a quick introduction to the Ultimate Ironman mode, as well as some guidance on getting started on a new Ultimate Ironman account. More in-depth skill training methods, quest tips, equipment suggestions, and more can be found on their respective pages. These pages can be navigated to using the icons in the top-right of each page, or by the links further down on this page.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Achievement Diaries
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Achievement Diaries
lead:
Achievement Diaries can be very beneficial as an Ultimate Iron Man. Completion of diaries will give unique rewards, experience, and unlocks certain content.

Completing diaries is generally the same as regular players, but there are a few tasks that are uniquely challenging for ultimate iron men.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Agility
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Agility
lead:
Agility training on an ultimate ironman is similar to training it on a regular account or an ironman. As a skill, Agility is very useful to train for unlocking shortcuts and improving run energy restoration. It also has the potential for money-making through the Agility Pyramid at lower levels, and looting the coffins in the Hallowed Sepulchre at higher. Agility also provides access to the graceful outfit, the ring of endurance, and stamina potions.

Ultimate Ironmen may find it difficult to fully take advantage of the Hallowed Sepulchre, though given how important the Ring of endurance is to run energy management it is recommended to always loot the Grand Hallowed Coffin.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Construction
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Construction
lead:
Construction unlocks various options for storing items. This makes it one of the most useful skills to train for ultimate ironmen. The storage options are centred primarily around the Costume Room in the player-owned house, where furniture like the magic wardrobe, armour case, and cape rack can be used to store a number of useful pieces of equipment. Construction also gives access to STASH units around the world, which can store a variety of useful items like the Slayer helmet, dragon axe, and abyssal whip.

For more information, see Ultimate Ironman Guide/Item Management.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Cooking
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Cooking
lead: Cooking is one of the fastest skills to train, even on an ultimate ironman. The skill itself is not particularly useful, as cooking food is often less convenient than simply buying food from a shop.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Crafting
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Crafting
lead: Crafting is typically trained with glassblowing. The skill is most notable as a source for high-level enchanted jewellery, for use in combat and as a way to teleport around the game. It is also useful for making crystal equipment and dragonhide armour for combat, as well as for making high-level bird houses for passive Hunter training.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Defence
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Defence
lead:
Defence is most often trained through combat. For more information about combat training on an Ultimate Ironman, see:
*Ultimate Ironman Guide/Melee
*Ultimate Ironman Guide/Ranged
*Ultimate Ironman Guide/Magic

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Equipment
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Equipment
lead:
Damage per second (DPS) is the most important stat for gear as shorter kill times result in saved time as well as less damage taken. Under the assumption that protective and damage boosting prayers are used, this results in a clear hierarchy of item stats: DPS > Prayer bonus > Defence bonus.

In practice this hierarchy means that inventory and bag space should only be used for items that (significantly) improve DPS. Furthermore, it may (occasionally) be worthwhile to use an inferior piece of gear that is storable instead of a slightly better piece of gear that is not storable outside of your looting bag. For instance, prior to obtaining Oathplate, many players will opt to wear the storable obsidian legs and a fighter torso rather than seek gear like Bandos armour.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Equipment/Two-handed slot table
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Equipment/Two-handed slot table
lead:
The Weapons table shows all two-handed weapons (Melee, Ranged and Magic) if it is storable in a player-owned house costume room, STASH units used for emote clues, or they are purchasable from stores.

Note: One-handed weapons are not listed here. Instead, they are found here.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Equipment/Weapon slot table
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Equipment/Weapon slot table
lead:
The Weapons table shows all weapons (Melee, Ranged and Magic) if it is storable in a player-owned house costume room, STASH units used for emote clues, or they are purchasable from stores.

Note: Two-handed weapons are not listed here. Instead, they are found here.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Farming
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Farming
lead: Farming is a tricky skill to train, split between collecting various seeds and actually using those seeds over time. Because most ways to get seeds provide a wide range of different seed types, it can be fairly inventory-stressful to actively train Farming with all sorts of seeds. For this reason, many players opt to only keep a few types of seeds, such as desirable herb seeds or high-level tree seeds, and farm them over time while training other skills. Despite the difficulty of training Farming, the skill is quite useful, providing herbs and secondary ingredients for Herblore training, logs for Construction training, and fast travel with Spirit trees.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Firemaking
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Firemaking
lead: Firemaking is a fairly straightforward skill to train, with most of the training recommended to be at the Wintertodt. Besides quest and Achievement Diary requirements, the skill does not provide much direct benefit to the player. The rewards from the Wintertodt can be a nice incentive to train the skill, however.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Fishing
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Fishing
lead: Fishing is most often trained through "powerfishing", where the caught fish are almost immediately dropped onto the ground to keep a relatively empty inventory. While the skill is classically a good source of food for combat training, the significant amount of preparation required to catch and cook fish makes it less useful for Ultimate Ironman players when compared to buyable food (such as cooked karambwans, jugs of wine, and potatoes with cheese) or noted Saradomin brews. At high Fishing levels, it is possible to get noted raw sharks from fishing minnows, which can be a solid food choice once cooked.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Fletching
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Fletching
lead:
Fletching is trained most efficiently by making broad arrows during other activities that have downtime while training. Because the supplies required to make arrows are all stackable, it is relatively easy to make room for them in most inventory setups for a variety of situations. All the supplies can be quickly bought in bulk, which makes fletching arrows a much more effective training method than fletching darts, bolts, or bows. However, doing so can cost a lot of money.

The Vale Totems minigame offers an alternative approach to Fletching training, with no input costs but lower experience rates.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Herblore
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Herblore
lead:
Herblore is one of the most challenging skills for ultimate ironman players. It is a very inventory-stressful skill to train as it requires a number of herbs, secondary ingredients, and potions in the inventory throughout the training process. Herblore is a very worthwhile skill to train however, as high-level potions are very useful in combat. In non-combat situations, players can also benefit from having stamina potions for restoring run energy.

Starting at level 60, Mastering Mixology offers a herblore training method that is slower but rewards more XP per herb and requires very little inventory space.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Hitpoints
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Hitpoints
lead:
Hitpoints is most often trained through combat. For more information about combat training on an Ultimate Ironman, see:
*Ultimate Ironman Guide/Melee
*Ultimate Ironman Guide/Ranged
*Ultimate Ironman Guide/Magic

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Hunter
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Hunter
lead: Hunter training on an ultimate ironman is very similar to that of a regular account or ironman. The skill is most notable as a source of bird nests for Saradomin brews, red chinchompas for Ranged combat, and grimy herbs for Herblore training with the herbiboar. Most methods require little preparation or inventory space, so Hunter can be feasibly combined with Farming training.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Item Management
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Item Management
lead: Ultimate Ironmen use many different methods to store items and to save inventory space due to their inability to bank. These include using various items that can store multiple items in a single inventory space, Item Retrieval Services that can serve as a temporary "bank" for storing items, storage furniture in the player-owned house, STASH units, and more. In this way, Ultimate Ironmen can have at least some flexibility in terms of what items they have available for different activities.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Magic
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Magic
lead:
Magic is one of the most useful skills for Ultimate Ironman players, as it is often the fastest way to travel, is crucial to a number of training methods, and is a powerful option in many high and low-level combat situations. Early Magic training can be somewhat slow, due to low-level spells giving little experience per cast, but later on the skill can be passively trained through use in other training methods or general travel or using high alchemy for making money.

For more information about Magic equipment, see Ultimate Ironman Guide/Equipment.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Melee
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Melee
lead:
Melee, including the Attack and Strength skills, is one of the core combat styles used throughout the game. Most melee training, as with other combat skills, will come passively through training Slayer, completing quests, or other combat situations. Between the two skills, it is recommended to keep them relatively close for low and mid-level training, with the goal of entering the Warriors' Guild as soon as possible. Afterwards, Strength is generally more important than Attack, except when reaching certain thresholds like the abyssal whip's level 70 Attack requirement.

For more information about melee equipment, see Ultimate Ironman Guide/Equipment.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Minigames
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Minigames
lead: Minigames can have restrictions that can be challenging for Ultimate Ironman players, often requiring significant preparation, inventory-stressful item requirements, and dangerous combat in unusual locations. In most cases, these challenges are similar to those for regular players, and with good preparation, the minigame can be completed much like any other player would.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Mining
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Mining
lead:
Mining training on an ultimate ironman is mostly relegated to "powermining" (where the ore is dropped rather than being smelted) due to inventory and banking restrictions. While this makes the skill relatively quick to train, it also means there is very little direct incentive to train the skill besides requirements such as those from quests and Achievement Diaries. That said, a high Mining level can be useful for some Mining-related activities, such Zalcano and Chambers of Xeric.

Pickaxes up to rune can be bought from the mining shops. Players who have the fancy jewellery box in their player-owned house can quickly access Yarsul's Prodigious Pickaxes in the Mining Guild (requires level 60 Mining) or Nurmof's Pickaxe Shop in the Dwarven Mine. Alternatively, players can use a minigame teleport to Blast Furnace and run a bit north to Pickaxe-Is-Mine.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Prayer
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Prayer
lead: Prayer is a challenging skill to train for ultimate ironman players, due to inventory space restrictions and their inability to use some of the faster training methods. However, there are a number of ways to train the skill, including many passive training methods that can provide decent amounts of experience over a long period of time. Early on, the primary focus of Prayer training is to reach level 43 Prayer, to unlock the protection prayers. Because of how important these core protection prayers are, some players opt to "rush" to level 43 Prayer early on their training through fast and risky training methods such as those in the Wilderness.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Quests
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Quests
lead: Quests often have unique restrictions, challenges, or dangers that make them particularly difficult for an Ultimate Ironman to complete. They can require significant preparation or having a lot of inventory space. In most cases, these challenges are similar to those for regular players, and with good preparation (often coupled with a good quest guide) the quest can be completed much like any other player would.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Ranged
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Ranged
lead:
Ranged is one of the core combat styles used throughout the game, being the best option in a variety of combat situations due to its high damage output, distance from the target, and ability to safespot many enemies.

For more information about Ranged equipment, see Ultimate Ironman Guide/Equipment.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Runecraft
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Runecraft
lead: Runecraft training provides valuable runes, which can be used for various spells or sold for profit. Training the skill is also very useful for getting wrath runes for Prayer and Slayer training. Most Runecraft training methods require a lot of inventory space and are safe, so players are advised to store their items at an Item Retrieval Service for more inventory space.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Sailing
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Sailing
lead:
Sailing unlocks access to various new islands and the ability to sail on ships.

As upgrading the ships is a non-trivial task on a UIM, it can be beneficial to skip those upgrades that aren't necessary.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Slayer
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Slayer
lead:
Slayer and its variety of unlockable Slayer monsters offer a number of benefits, from high-level combat equipment to resources used for training skills. Items like the abyssal whip, occult necklace, and dragon hunter lance are amongst the strongest and most core pieces of combat gear, and high-level Slayer monsters like gargoyles, aberrant spectres, and nechryaels drop all sorts of useful supplies. Training Slayer as an Ultimate Ironman presents a number of unique challenges, as the player must balance different equipment, monster drops, supplies, and more while fighting some of the most difficult monsters in the game.

For more information about combat equipment, see Ultimate Ironman Guide/Equipment.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Smithing
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Smithing
lead: Smithing is most often trained at the Blast Furnace using the nearby shop to provide the ores. The Giants' Foundry minigame is a slower but cheaper and more accessible alternative. As a skill, Smithing is useful as a source of high-level dart tips for Fletching and Ranged. At higher levels, players can also smith valuable adamant and rune equipment, which can be alched for profit.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Stat Restoration
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Stat Restoration
lead: Ultimate Ironman players often find themselves in need of restoring various stats such as Run energy, Hitpoints, Prayer points, Poison status, Special attack energy and various lowered stats such as Attack or Agility during various Slayer or Bossing activities like Barrows. Clan wars teleport via Ring of dueling or Minigame Teleport is a good way to restore stats as an early/mid level UIM. Due to needing to craft a new ring every 8 teleports, players may opt to hold a few in their inventory depending on what they are training, and if far enough may store extra ones in an Item Retrieval Service. Explorer's ring is a good unlock that will recover run energy a limited amount of times per day depending on which level of the Lumbridge diary the player has done. At level 81 Construction players may build the Basic jewellery box, providing the player unlimited Ring of dueling charges, this can be achieved earlier by boosting Construction. The best method for stat restoration is the Ornate rejuvenation pool, requiring 90 Construction. This will allow players to restore Hitpoints, special attack, run energy, Prayer points, and any reduced stats, as well as curing venom, disease, and poison in their Player-owned house.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Thieving
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Thieving
lead:
Thieving training on an ultimate ironman is relatively similar to that for regular accounts or an ironman. Most training methods require few items and little preparation to do effectively. This also makes the skill easy to train in conjunction with other inventory-stressful skills, most notably Farming. As a skill, Thieving is most useful as a source of coins and seeds through pickpocketing, as well as the Pharaoh's sceptre from Pyramid Plunder.

There are a number of items that can be useful for Thieving training, most notably the Rogue equipment set, which doubles all loot from pickpocketing NPCs. It is highly recommended to get the set before training Thieving much past level 50, though it may be useful to wait until a high Construction level for access to easier storage in the player-owned house armour case. The Ardougne Diary also gives bonuses when pickpocketing NPCs, making them less likely to notice the player's attempts.

label: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Woodcutting
title: Ultimate Ironman Guide/Woodcutting
lead: Woodcutting can be trained in a number of ways, including simply cutting and dropping the logs, training it in tandem with Construction, or training it passively through activities like the Wintertodt. Woodcutting is most useful as a source for Construction planks of all levels, though it can also be useful for Firemaking and Fletching training in some cases. Low level axes to train the skill can be most easily bought from Bob's Brilliant Axes in Lumbridge, with high level axes being available at Perry's Chop-chop Shop at the Woodcutting Guild.

label: Ultimate Ironman Mode
title: Ultimate Ironman Mode
lead: Ultimate Ironman mode is an official game mode that players can choose to assign themselves. It has all of the restrictions of ironman mode with the additional restriction that ultimate ironmen cannot use banks. There are many other unique restrictions that follow from the inability to use a bank.

label: Ultimate Strength
title: Ultimate Strength
lead:
Ultimate Strength is a prayer unlocked at level 31 Prayer. Ultimate Strength increases the player's Strength by 15%.

Like all other stat-affecting prayers, it cannot be used in conjunction with another prayer that increases the player's Strength level, such as Piety.

label: Umbral
title: Umbral
lead:
Umbral may refer to:
*Umbral frag used to grow an umbral coral plant
*Umbral coral harvested from an umbral coral plant
*Umbral coral plant
*Umbra, one of the four mages guarding Nex in the Ancient Prison, within in the God Wars Dungeon

label: Unannounced phenomena
title: Unannounced phenomena
lead: Unannounced phenomena are various events in Old School RuneScape that have at one time or another hinted to future updates.

label: Unarmed
title: Unarmed
lead:
Unarmed is a style of combat in which a player is fighting with no weapons equipped. As a result, the player has no attack bonuses, besides those that may come from other items that may be equipped, such as an amulet.

In melee combat, unarmed fighting is possible through the unarmed fighting styles listed below. Most combat spells can be cast without weapon equipped, making Magic a strong option for encounters where no weapons are used. Ranged combat is not possible without a weapon, as every ranged projectile either needs to be equipped in the weapon slot, or launched from a ranged weapon.

label: unblessed symbol
title: unblessed symbol
lead:
Unblessed symbols are made by using a ball of wool with an unstrung symbol, granting the player 4 Crafting experience.

Players with a Prayer level of 31 or higher can have their unblessed symbols blessed by Brother Jered in the Edgeville Monastery, turning them into holy symbols.

label: Uncle Joe
title: Uncle Joe
lead: Uncle Joe was the uncle of the crab Snip Snip. Joe was a rock crab who lived near an unnamed sea. He was attacked by the first from a crowd of adventurers, and, after a vicious battle, was killed. His death is lamented by his nephew in a poem in the 11th Postbag from the Hedge.

label: Uncooked apple pie
title: Uncooked apple pie
lead:
An uncooked apple pie is an uncooked food item made by using a cooking apple on a pie shell that has already had pastry dough added to it. Players need at least level 30 Cooking to make it. If successfully cooked, an apple pie provides 130 Cooking experience.

The uncooked pie can be cooked on a range (but not a fire) to make an apple pie. However, there is a risk that the pie will burn and become a burnt pie. Like other pies, apple pies can also be cooked with the Lunar spell Bake Pie without the chance of burning.

label: Uncooked berry pie
title: Uncooked berry pie
lead: An Uncooked berry pie is made by adding Redberries to a Pie shell. Its cooked variant is a redberry pie.

label: Uncooked cake
title: Uncooked cake
lead: Uncooked cake can be made with the Cooking skill by using an egg, a bucket of milk, and a pot of flour with a cake tin. To bake a cake, players must use it on a range with level 40+ Cooking. This will either turn the uncooked cake into a Cake or it will burn the cake (burnt cakes have no use). After cooking the cake, successfully or burnt, the player will receive back their cake tin. Optionally, at Cooking level 50+, players may then use a chocolate bar (which can be found in the Cooks' Guild) or chocolate dust on the cake to make a chocolate cake.

label: Uncooked curry
title: Uncooked curry
lead:
Uncooked curry is made by adding a potato and either cooked meat or cooked chicken to a bowl of water (in any order) to create uncooked stew, then adding either three curry leaves or one spice. The final product is the same regardless of which of the two types of meat is used.

At level 60 Cooking, it can be cooked to make curry, granting 280 experience. Burning it will produce burnt curry. The player stops burning curry at level 74 Cooking.

label: Uncooked meat pie
title: Uncooked meat pie
lead: An uncooked meat pie is made by adding cooked meat or cooked chicken to a pie shell. It can be cooked to make meat pie, or if unsuccessful, a Burnt pie.

label: Uncooked pizza
title: Uncooked pizza
lead: Uncooked pizza requires 35 Cooking to make and is obtained by using a pizza base with tomato and cheese. It can be cooked on a range (but not a fire) into a plain pizza, which gives 143 Cooking experience. Some toppings can then be added, see the pizza page for more details. It is possible to fail the cooking, which will result in a burnt pizza.

label: Uncooked stew
title: Uncooked stew
lead:
Uncooked stew is an inedible food made using the Cooking skill. It is created by adding a raw potato and either cooked meat or cooked chicken into a bowl of water; the product is the same regardless of which type of meat is used. The ingredients can be added in any order.

Adding a first ingredient creates an incomplete stew and adding the second ingredient creates the uncooked stew. It can then be cooked at level 25 Cooking to make stew, granting 117 experience. Alternatively, adding three curry leaves or one spice before cooking the stew produces an uncooked curry, which can be cooked at level 60 Cooking to make curry, granting 280 experience.

label: Uncut diamond
title: Uncut diamond
lead:
An uncut diamond is a precious gem used in Crafting. It can be cut with a chisel to make a diamond, requiring 43 Crafting and yielding 107.5 experience.

Uncut diamonds can be obtained in several ways: randomly while mining ores, as drops from monsters (mainly those which have access to the rare drop table), gem shops, or as a reward from certain minigames and random events. They are also a common reward from Managing Miscellania.

label: Uncut dragonstone
title: Uncut dragonstone
lead:
Uncut dragonstones are rare gems which can be cut into dragonstones, requiring 55 Crafting and granting 137.5 experience. They can be obtained from the crystal chest in Taverley, unlocked with a crystal key, along with other various items.

While uncut dragonstones are available from the gem shop within Mor Ul Rek for 1,500 Tokkul, they are not in stock unless sold by another player. Their cut counterparts are dropped very rarely by a wide variety of monsters.

label: Uncut emerald
title: Uncut emerald
lead:
An uncut emerald is a precious gem used in Crafting. It can be cut with a chisel to make an emerald, requiring 27 Crafting and yielding 67.5 experience.

Uncut emeralds can be obtained in several ways: randomly while mining ores, as drops from monsters (mainly those which have access to the rare drop table), gem shops, or as a reward from certain minigames and random events. They are also a common reward from Managing Miscellania.

label: Uncut gem
title: Uncut gem
lead:
An uncut gem is cut into a gem using Crafting. Uncut gems are obtained from mining, bags full of gems, random events, minigame, gem shops, gem stalls, thieving, and as drops from monsters.

They can also be mined from gem rocks in the Shilo Village mine, Lunar Isle Mine, or from the Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup minigame.

label: Uncut jade
title: Uncut jade
lead:
An uncut jade is a semi-precious gem used in Crafting. It can be cut with a chisel at level 13 Crafting to make a jade, granting 20 experience. There is a chance to unsuccessfully cut the jade, resulting in a crushed gem and 5 experience.

Uncut jades are found mostly with the Mining skill, only by mining gem rocks which are located in Shilo Village after a player has completed the Shilo Village quest, in the Lunar Isle mine after Lunar Diplomacy, or on The Onyx Crest after 47 Sailing; or by mining the shell of the Gemstone Crab. Jades can also be found while panning at the Digsite near the River Salve, or they may be stolen from H.A.M members via the Thieving skill.

label: Uncut opal
title: Uncut opal
lead:
An uncut opal is a semi-precious gem used in Crafting. It can be cut with a chisel to make an opal, granting 15 Crafting experience. There is a chance to unsuccessfully cut the opal, resulting in a crushed gem and 3.8 experience. Opals are the lowest level gemstone and are worth very little.

Uncut opals are found mostly with the Mining skill, only by mining gem rocks which are located in Shilo Village after a player has completed the Shilo Village quest, in the Lunar Isle mine after Lunar Diplomacy, or on The Onyx Crest after 47 Sailing; or by mining the shell of the Gemstone Crab. Opals can also be found while panning at the Digsite near the River Salve, or they may be stolen from H.A.M members via the Thieving skill.

label: Uncut red topaz
title: Uncut red topaz
lead:
An uncut red topaz is a semi-precious gem used in Crafting. It can be cut with a chisel at level 16 Crafting to make a red topaz, granting 25 experience. There is a chance to unsuccessfully cut the red topaz, resulting in a crushed gem and 6.3 experience.

Uncut red topaz is found mostly with the Mining skill, only by mining gem rocks which are located in Shilo Village after a player has completed the Shilo Village quest, in the Lunar Isle mine after Lunar Diplomacy, or on The Onyx Crest after 47 Sailing, or by mining the shell of the Gemstone Crab. They can also be obtained by completing hard Gnome Restaurant deliveries, by stealing from Dorgesh-Kaan Rich Chests, by completing the Wise Old Man's tasks, or by salvaging merchant shipwrecks. In addition, there is a very rare chance to find one while searching certain scenery objects across Gielinor.

label: Uncut ruby
title: Uncut ruby
lead:
An uncut ruby is a precious gem used in Crafting. It can be cut with a chisel to make a ruby, requiring 34 Crafting and yielding 85 experience.

Uncut rubies can be obtained in several ways: randomly while mining ores, as drops from monsters (mainly those which have access to the rare drop table), gem shops, or as a reward from certain minigames and random events. They are also a common reward from Managing Miscellania.

label: Uncut sapphire
title: Uncut sapphire
lead:
An uncut sapphire is a precious gem used in Crafting. It can be cut with a chisel to make a sapphire, requiring 20 Crafting and yielding 50 experience.

Uncut sapphires can be obtained in several ways: randomly while mining ores, as drops from monsters (mainly those which have access to the rare drop table), gem shops, or as a reward from certain minigames and random events. They are also a common reward from Managing Miscellania.

label: Undead
title: Undead
lead:
Undead are monsters or NPCs in Old School RuneScape that are dead, but not gone; they have often been revived by a necromancer or created purely from magic. Undead encompasses everything from reanimated corpses to ghosts, spirits and other spectral creatures. Generally, most undead monsters are affected by the damage and accuracy enhancements of the salve amulet and its variants, as well as the Crumble Undead spell. The majority of the Undead are found in the more inauspicious of Gielinor's regions, such as Morytania, the Wilderness, and numerous dungeons.

Contrary to how they are portrayed in some folklore, Vampyres do not count as undead.

label: Undead (attribute)
title: Undead (attribute)
lead: Undead is an attribute assigned to monsters weak to the effects of salve amulet and the Crumble Undead spell. Many monsters with the spectral attribute also classify as undead, with several exceptions, as listed below.

label: Undead combat dummy (interface item)
title: Undead combat dummy (interface item)
lead:
The Undead combat dummy is an interface item that can be seen in the Construction skill guide representing the Undead combat dummy.

The actual item cannot be obtained by players.

label: Undead one
title: Undead one
lead:
The Undead ones play a critical part in the Shilo Village quest. Both skeletal and zombie undead ones are found in Ah Za Rhoon and Rashiliyia's Tomb, whereas the zombie undead ones are also found at the entrance to Shilo Village.

When the zombie variant is killed, they have the chance to release shilo mist that would damage the player for 2-3 Hitpoints per hit. However, it is not poisonous, so Antipoison is not required. The gas only affects characters in a one-square radius around where the undead one was when it was killed, so if players kill one, they have a few seconds to run to avoid taking damage.

label: Undead tree
title: Undead tree
lead:
Undead trees are located in the front yard of Draynor Manor and in the Haunted Woods. Unlike the dead trees surrounding them, they attack players walking past them for 0 to 3 melee damage. Undead trees maintain aggressiveness regardless of a player's combat level, and follow standard rules for tolerance. They can be spotted by their yellow examine option, identifying them as an NPC, and are also slightly smaller in size.

Undead trees cannot be cut until the Animal Magnetism quest, where the player obtains a blessed axe. Attempting to chop the tree with no axe results in the message You don't have an axe which could possibly affect this wood. Attempting to chop the tree with any axe other than the blessed axe will result in the message The axe bounces off the undead wood. and an animation of swinging the axe and it bouncing off the tree. It is also currently not possible to chop down the tree through intentional mechanics. 35 Woodcutting is required to cut the tree, having less results in the message You need a Woodcutting level of 35 or more in order to cut this tree. A Slayer level of 18 is required to chop the tree, having less results in the message

label: Undercurrent
title: Undercurrent
lead:
Undercurrent is a music track that can be unlocked in the Wilderness and also plays in Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon.

In Classic mode, the track plays in the Wilderness between the Bandit Camp and the Graveyard of Shadows.

label: Underground (music track)
title: Underground (music track)
lead:
Underground is a music track that is unlocked in various locations around Gielinor:
*Wilderness
*Wilderness Agility Course Dungeon
*Entrana Dungeon
*Deepfin Mine
*Area of Taverley Dungeon containing Black Demons.

It also plays in the Nightmare Zone when facing the Tree spirit in Practice or Endurance mode.

label: Underground Pass
title: Underground Pass
lead: Underground Pass is the third quest in the Elf quest series, and explores an extensive and perilous dungeon to the west of Ardougne. You must venture through the pass at the request of King Lathas, in order to help him destroy his corrupted brother Tyras.

label: Underground Pass (dungeon)
title: Underground Pass (dungeon)
lead: The Underground Pass is one of the pathways to reach Tirannwn, the elven lands of western Gielinor. Traversing the enormous and hostile dungeon is the focus of the eponymous Underground Pass quest.

label: Underground Pass (music track)
title: Underground Pass (music track)
lead: Underground Pass is a music track that is unlocked during the Underground Pass quest. It is unlocked in the second area of the Underground Pass, and in the pitfall trap underneath the grid in the first area.

label: Understanding
title: Understanding
lead:
Understanding is a music track that is unlocked at the Nature Altar.

This is only unlocked when entering the altar directly and is not unlocked through Guardians of the Rift.

label: Underwall tunnel
title: Underwall tunnel
lead: Underwall tunnel may refer to several Agility shortcuts. The shortcuts do not give any experience.

label: Underwater (disambiguation)
title: Underwater (disambiguation)
lead:
Underwater may refer to:

*Mogre Camp, a Mogre settlement below the seas near Port Khazard
*Underwater, an area beneath the waters of Fossil Island
*Underwater Tunnel, a cavern below Harmony Island
*Coral Nurseries, an area below the waters of The Great Conch

label: Underwater Agility and Thieving
title: Underwater Agility and Thieving
lead:
This activity is a unique way of training the Agility and Thieving skills. This activity takes place in part of the Underwater area of Fossil Island. It is also referred to as "swimming" by players.

The mermaid Mairin guards the area. To enter, players must first speak to Mairin, who will ask them to remove their fishbowl helmet. After entering, players will find a scattered layout of treasure chests and giant clam shells as well as several tunnels, holes and other obstacles, such as currents, which can be traversed.

label: Unfermented wine
title: Unfermented wine
lead:
An Unfermented wine is created when a player with a Cooking level of 35 or more uses grapes with a jug of water. After 12 seconds, this item will automatically turn to either a jug of wine, granting 200 Cooking experience, or a jug of bad wine, granting none. With 14 wines possible per inventory, each inventory grants you 2800 experience once fermented. The player will also stop making bad wine at level 68 Cooking.

Wine ferments on a single 12 second timer that resets each time the player makes a new jug of unfermented wine, whether banked or in their inventory. This means that any stack of wine in their bank will ferment all at once. Due to that, players can obtain massive amounts of experience in one tick.

label: Unfermented wine (unobtainable item)
title: Unfermented wine (unobtainable item)
lead:
Unfermented wine is an unobtainable version of Unfermented wine. Unfermented wines could previously be traded and turned into bank notes; however, they were made untradeable in 2007 due to frequent use in scams where players conflated them with Half full wine jugs. Any player who had a noted unfermented wine was given this now discontinued item. It is identical to the real wine, except it is stackable.

As this change occurred prior to August 2007, the item has never been obtainable in Old School RuneScape.

label: Unferth
title: Unferth
lead:
Unferth is the human pet of Bob the Jagex cat. He is the starting point for the 'A Tail of Two Cats' quest, in which he asks the player to find his missing pet cat, Bob.

The Apothecary states that Unferth is a hypochondriac, and gets fed up every time he comes to him seeking a cure for his "illness".

label: Unfinished batta
title: Unfinished batta
lead:
An unfinished batta is created by baking a half made batta. The unfinished batta can be garnished with gnome spice or equa leaves, as specified in the recipe, to create the finished fruit batta, worm batta, vegetable batta or cheese+tom batta.
*Unfinished batta (fruit)
*Unfinished batta (worm)
*Unfinished batta (vegetable)
*Unfinished batta (cheese+tom)

label: Unfinished batta (cheese+tom, historical)
title: Unfinished batta (cheese+tom, historical)
lead:
An unfinished batta was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making a Cheese+tom batta. It could be made by adding Cheese and a Tomato to a Half baked batta, then baking it. Finally, Equa leaves were added to create a Cheese+tom batta. If a mistake was made at any point, an Odd batta would be received instead.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, all ingredients are automatically added to create a Half made batta, which can then be cooked to produce the new Unfinished batta. Once again, equa leaves are used to convert this into a Cheese+tom batta.

label: Unfinished batta (fruit, historical)
title: Unfinished batta (fruit, historical)
lead:
An unfinished batta was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making a Fruit batta. It could be made by adding four equa leaves to a Half baked batta, then baking it. Players then could add lime chunks, orange chunks, and pineapple chunks in any order, before finally adding Gnome spice. If a mistake was made at any point, an Odd batta would be received instead.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, all ingredients are automatically added to create a Half made batta, which can then be cooked to produce the new Unfinished batta. Once again, gnome spice is used to convert this into a Fruit batta.

label: Unfinished batta (vegetable, historical)
title: Unfinished batta (vegetable, historical)
lead:
An unfinished batta was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making a Vegetable batta. It could be made by adding two Tomatoes, an Onion, a Cabbage, some Dwellberries, and some Cheese to a Half baked batta, then baking it. Finally Equa leaves were added to make a Vegetable batta. If a mistake was made at any point, an Odd batta would be received instead.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, all ingredients are automatically added to create a Half made batta, which can then be cooked to produce the new Unfinished batta. Once again, equa leaves are used to convert this into a Vegetable batta.

label: Unfinished batta (worm, historical)
title: Unfinished batta (worm, historical)
lead:
An unfinished batta was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making a Worm batta. It could be made by adding a Spicy worm and some cheese to a Half baked batta, then baking it. Finally, Equa leaves were added to make a Worm batta. If a mistake was made at any point, an Odd batta would be received instead.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, all ingredients are automatically added to create a Half made batta, which can then be cooked to produce the new Unfinished batta. Once again, equa leaves are used to convert this into a Worm batta.

label: Unfinished bolts
title: Unfinished bolts
lead: Unfinished or unfeathered bolts are flight-less crossbow bolts that can be smithed from metal bars with the exception of broad and dragon bolts, which cannot be made by the Smithing skill. Also, silver bolts are made with the Crafting skill instead. Nonetheless, each bar produces 10 unfinished bolts, and feathers are added to finish them based on the Fletching skill.

label: Unfinished bowl
title: Unfinished bowl
lead:
An unfinished bowl is an intermediate step in gnomebowl-based gnome cooking for a chocolate bomb, worm hole or veg ball. It is created after baking the half made bowl, which also releases the gnomebowl mould back into your inventory for reuse. Final ingredients then need to be added to create the final dish.
*Unfinished bowl (worm hole)
*Unfinished bowl (veg ball)
*Unfinished bowl (chocolate bomb)

label: Unfinished bowl (chocolate bomb, historical)
title: Unfinished bowl (chocolate bomb, historical)
lead:
An unfinished bowl was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making a Chocolate bomb. It could be made by adding four Chocolate bars and some Equa leaves to a Half baked bowl, then baking it. The following items could then be added:
# A pot of cream to make the second unfinished bowl
# Another pot of cream to make the third unfinished bowl
# Some chocolate dust to complete the chocolate bomb
If a mistake was made at any point, an Odd gnomebowl would be received instead.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, the initial ingredients are automatically added to create a Half made bowl, which can then be cooked to produce the new Unfinished bowl. The chocolate and cream garnishes are now added at once.

label: Unfinished bowl (veg ball, historical)
title: Unfinished bowl (veg ball, historical)
lead:
An unfinished bowl was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making a Veg ball. It could be made by adding two Onions, two Potatos, and some Gnome spice to a Half baked bowl, then baking it. Finally, Equa leaves were added to make a veg ball. If a mistake was made at any point, an Odd gnomebowl would be received instead.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, all ingredients are automatically added to create a Half made bowl, which can then be cooked to produce the new Unfinished bowl. Once again, equa leaves are used to convert this into a Veg ball.

label: Unfinished bowl (worm hole, historical)
title: Unfinished bowl (worm hole, historical)
lead:
An unfinished bowl was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making a Worm hole. It could be made by adding four King worms, two Onions, and some Gnome spice to a Half baked bowl, then baking it. Finally, Equa leaves were added to make a worm hole. If a mistake was made at any point, an Odd gnomebowl would be received instead.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, all ingredients are automatically added to create a Half made bowl, which can then be cooked to produce the new Unfinished bowl. Once again, equa leaves are used to convert this into a Worm hole.

label: Unfinished cocktail
title: Unfinished cocktail
lead:
Unfinished cocktail may refer to:
*Mixed blast, an unfinished Fruit blast.
*Mixed blizzard, an unfinished Wizard blizzard.
*Mixed punch, an unfinished Pineapple punch.
*Mixed sgg, an unfinished Short green guy.
*Mixed special, an unfinished Blurberry special.

*Mixed dragon, an unfinished Drunk dragon.
**Mixed dragon (shaker)
**Mixed dragon (poured)
**Mixed dragon (garnished)
*Mixed saturday, an unfinished Choc saturday.
**Mixed saturday (shaker)
**Mixed saturday (poured)
**Mixed saturday (heated)

label: Unfinished cocktail (Blurberry special, historical)
title: Unfinished cocktail (Blurberry special, historical)
lead:
An unfinished cocktail was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making a Blurberry special. It could be made by adding Vodka, Gin, Brandy, two Lemons, and an Orange to a Cocktail shaker, then pouring this into a Cocktail glass.
The following secondary items could then be added:
# Some orange chunks to make the second unfinished cocktail
# Some lemon chunks to make the third unfinished cocktail
# Some lime slices to make the fourth unfinished cocktail
# Some equa leaves to complete the Blurberry special
If a mistake was made at any point, an Odd cocktail would be received instead.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, the initial ingredients are automatically added to the cocktail shaker to create a Mixed special. The secondary ingredients are also automatically added at once by pouring the Mixed special into a cocktail glass.

label: Unfinished cocktail (Choc saturday, historical)
title: Unfinished cocktail (Choc saturday, historical)
lead:
An unfinished cocktail was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making a Choc saturday. It could be made by adding Whisky, some Equa leaves and a Bucket of milk to a Cocktail shaker, then pouring this into a Cocktail glass.
The following secondary items could then be added:
# A chocolate bar to make the second unfinished cocktail
# Cooking it to make the third unfinished cocktail
# A pot of cream to make the fourth unfinished cocktail
# Some chocolate dust to complete the Choc saturday
If a mistake was made at any point, an Odd cocktail would be received instead.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, the initial ingredients are automatically added to the cocktail shaker to create a Mixed saturday (shaker). Unlike most other Gnome cuisine, this recipe still contains additional steps. Although the chocolate bar is now added automatically, the Mixed saturday must still be poured into a cocktail glass and cooked, with the pot of cream and chocolate dust added afterwards.

label: Unfinished cocktail (Drunk dragon, historical)
title: Unfinished cocktail (Drunk dragon, historical)
lead:
An unfinished cocktail was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making a Drunk dragon. It could be made by adding Vodka, Gin, and some Dwellberries to a Cocktail shaker, then pouring this into a Cocktail glass.
The following secondary items could then be added:
# Some pineapple chunks to make the second unfinished cocktail
# A pot of cream to make the third unfinished cocktail
# Cooking it to complete the Drunk dragon
If a mistake was made at any point, an Odd cocktail would be received instead.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, the initial ingredients are automatically added to the cocktail shaker to create a Mixed dragon (shaker). Unlike most other Gnome cuisine, this recipe still contains additional steps. The Mixed dragon must still be poured into a cocktail glass, with the pineapple chunks and pot of cream being added next, and finally cooked.

label: Unfinished cocktail (Fruit blast, historical)
title: Unfinished cocktail (Fruit blast, historical)
lead:
An unfinished cocktail was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making a Fruit blast. It could be made by adding a Pineapple, an Orange, and a Lemon to a Cocktail shaker, then pouring this into a Cocktail glass. Some Lemon slices could then be added to complete the Fruit blast. If a mistake was made at any point, an Odd cocktail would be received instead.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, the initial ingredients are automatically added to the cocktail shaker to create a Mixed blast. The secondary ingredients are also automatically added at once by pouring the Mixed blast into a cocktail glass.

label: Unfinished cocktail (Pineapple punch, historical)
title: Unfinished cocktail (Pineapple punch, historical)
lead:
An unfinished cocktail was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making a Pineapple punch. It could be made by adding two Pineapples, a Lemon and an Orange to a Cocktail shaker, then pouring this into a Cocktail glass.
The following secondary items could then be added:
# Some pineapple chunks to make the second unfinished cocktail
# Some lime chunks to make the third unfinished cocktail
# Some orange slices to complete the pineapple punch
If a mistake was made at any point, an Odd cocktail would be received instead.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, the initial ingredients are automatically added to the cocktail shaker to create a Mixed punch. The secondary ingredients are also automatically added at once by pouring the Mixed punch into a cocktail glass.

label: Unfinished cocktail (Short green guy, historical)
title: Unfinished cocktail (Short green guy, historical)
lead:
An unfinished cocktail was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making a Short green guy. It could be made by adding a bottle of Vodka and three Limes to a Cocktail shaker, then pouring this into a Cocktail glass.
The following secondary items could then be added:
# Some equa leaves to make the second unfinished cocktail
# Some lime slices to complete the short green guy
If a mistake was made at any point, an Odd cocktail would be received instead.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, the initial ingredients are automatically added to the cocktail shaker to create a Mixed sgg. The secondary ingredients are also automatically added at once by pouring the Mixed sgg into a cocktail glass.

label: Unfinished cocktail (Wizard blizzard, historical)
title: Unfinished cocktail (Wizard blizzard, historical)
lead:
An unfinished cocktail was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making a Wizard blizzard. It could be made by adding two bottles of Vodka, some Gin, a Pineapple, an Orange, a Lime, and a Lemon to a Cocktail shaker, then pouring this into a Cocktail glass.
The following secondary items could then be added:
# Some pineapple chunks to make the second unfinished cocktail
# Some lime slices to complete the wizard blizzard
If a mistake was made at any point, an Odd cocktail would be received instead.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, the initial ingredients are automatically added to the cocktail shaker to create a Mixed blizzard. The secondary ingredients are also automatically added at once by pouring the Mixed blizzard into a cocktail glass.

label: Unfinished crunchy
title: Unfinished crunchy
lead:
An unfinished crunchy is an item created in gnome cooking by cooking a half made crunchy on a range. The unfinished crunchy can be garnished with gnome spice, chocolate dust or equa leaves, as specified in the recipe, to create the finished toad crunchies, spicy crunchies, worm crunchies or chocchip crunchies.
*Unfinished crunchy (toad)
*Unfinished crunchy (spicy)
*Unfinished crunchy (worm)
*Unfinished crunchy (chocchip)

label: Unfinished crunchy (chocchip, historical)
title: Unfinished crunchy (chocchip, historical)
lead:
An unfinished crunchy was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making Chocchip crunchies. It could be made by adding two Chocolate bars and some Gnome spice to a Half baked crunchy, then baking it. Finally, Chocolate dust was added to make some Chocchip crunchies. If a mistake was made at any point, some Odd crunchies would be received instead.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, all ingredients are automatically added to create a Half made crunchy, which can then be cooked to produce the new Unfinished crunchy. Once again, equa leaves are used to convert this into some Chocchip crunchies.

label: Unfinished crunchy (spicy, historical)
title: Unfinished crunchy (spicy, historical)
lead:
An unfinished crunchy was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making Spicy crunchies. It could be made by adding three portions of Gnome spice and two Equa leaves to a Half baked crunchy, then baking it. Finally, some Gnome spice was added to make some Spicy crunchies. If a mistake was made at any point, some Odd crunchies would be received instead.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, all ingredients are automatically added to create a Half made crunchy, which can then be cooked to produce the new Unfinished crunchy. Once again, equa leaves are used to convert this into some Spicy crunchies.

label: Unfinished crunchy (toad, historical)
title: Unfinished crunchy (toad, historical)
lead:
An unfinished crunchy was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making Toad crunchies. It could be made by adding two Toad's legs and some Gnome spice to a Half baked crunchy, then baking it. Finally, Equa leaves were added to make some Toad crunchies. If a mistake was made at any point, some Odd crunchies would be received instead.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, all ingredients are automatically added to create a Half made crunchy, which can then be cooked to produce the new Unfinished crunchy. Once again, equa leaves are used to convert this into some Toad crunchies.

label: Unfinished crunchy (worm, historical)
title: Unfinished crunchy (worm, historical)
lead:
An unfinished crunchy was previously obtained during Gnome cooking when making Worm crunchies. It could be made by adding two King worms, some Equa leaves, and some Gnome spice to a Half baked crunchy, then baking it. Finally, Gnome spice was added to make some Worm crunchies. If a mistake was made at any point, some Odd crunchies would be received instead.

As this process was unnecessarily intricate, it was altered with the Gnome Restaurant rework in 2006. Now, all ingredients are automatically added to create a Half made crunchy, which can then be cooked to produce the new Unfinished crunchy. Once again, equa leaves are used to convert this into some Worm crunchies.

label: Unfinished potion (disambiguation)
title: Unfinished potion (disambiguation)
lead: An unfinished potion is the result of adding a clean herb to a vial of water, vial of blood, or coconut milk using the Herblore skill. Another (secondary) ingredient must then be added to make a usable potion.

label: Unfired bowl
title: Unfired bowl
lead:
An unfired bowl is made by using soft clay on a potter's wheel which requires 8 Crafting and yields 18 Crafting experience. The unfired bowl can be fired in a pottery oven to produce a bowl, granting 15 Crafting experience upon success. Unlike shaping the clay, firing it has no Crafting level requirement. At lower levels, the bowl can crack in the oven, destroying the bowl and granting no experience.

For the quest Dragon Slayer I, an unfired bowl is required as one of four items in order to obtain Thalzar's map piece from the Oracle on Ice Mountain.

label: Unfired pie dish
title: Unfired pie dish
lead: An unfired pie dish is made by using soft clay on a potter's wheel, which requires level 7 Crafting and yields 15 Crafting experience. The unfired pie dish can be fired in a pottery oven to produce a pie dish, granting 10 Crafting experience upon success. Unlike shaping the clay, firing it has no Crafting level requirement. At lower levels, an unfired pie dish can crack in the oven, destroying the pie dish and granting no experience.

label: Unfired pot
title: Unfired pot
lead: An unfired pot is made by using soft clay on a potter's wheel, which requires level 1 Crafting and yields 6.3 Crafting experience. The unfired pot can be fired in a pottery oven to produce a pot, granting 6.3 Crafting experience upon success. Unlike shaping the clay, firing it has no Crafting level requirement. At lower levels, an unfired pot can crack in the oven, destroying the pot and granting no experience.

label: Ungadulu
title: Ungadulu
lead:
Ungadulu is a shaman who is possessed by Nezikchened during the Legends' Quest. He has a combat level of 70, which becomes 169 when his demonic possession overcomes him. His height also increases by a bit when he changes into his demonic possessed form. Despite this, Ungadulu cannot be attacked with melee or ranged weapons; he will throw players out of the Octagram, hitting them for between 4 and 10 damage. However, players can manually cast combat spells on him both inside and outside the Octagram to damage and kill him without being thrown by his spell. Players may also use Dynamite(p) to damage and kill Ungadulu.

After the quest, Yommi tree seeds and Holy force cannot be obtained.

label: Unholy mould
title: Unholy mould
lead:
An unholy mould is a mould which is used to make silver bars into unpowered symbols using the Crafting skill. To do this, the player can use it on any furnace using the Crafting skill. Unholy moulds can be found by speaking to the Spirit of Scorpius at his grave after completion of the Observatory Quest.

It is also a rare drop from chaos druids and elder chaos druids after completion of the quest. Zombies in Tarn's Lair can also drop them, even if the quest hasn't been completed.

label: Unholy symbol
title: Unholy symbol
lead:
An unholy symbol is a silver symbol blessed to imbue it with the unholy power of Zamorak. Players can make unholy symbols by using the Crafting skill, with a Crafting level of 17. First, a player must use a silver bar with a furnace while they have an unholy mould in their inventory and must have one free inventory space. This will give the player an unstrung emblem and they will receive 50 Crafting experience. Next, the player must string the symbol with a ball of wool, giving the player 4 Crafting experience and making the item into an unpowered symbol.

Finally, the symbol must be blessed either by the Spirit of Scorpius at the Grave of Scorpius, north of the Observatory, or by using an unholy book or book of balance with it. To bless the symbol using one of the books, a player must have a Prayer level of 50 or higher, and blessing the symbol makes the player expend (\frac{1}{10} * CurrentPrayerPoints) + 2 amount of Prayer points. Once blessed, the unpowered symbol becomes an unholy symbol and gains stat bonuses.

label: unicorn
title: unicorn
lead:
Unicorns can be commonly found wandering around forested areas. On members servers, unicorns drop the unicorn horn, which are used in Herblore to make antipoisons. Unicorns are one of the oldest monsters in the game, having initially appeared during the beta of RuneScape Classic. They are also one of the most updated monsters, having received four graphical updates since their release.

They respawn slowly, at a rate of ~53 seconds. Due to the relative length of respawn compared to how quickly they can be killed, it is advisable to farm them in the Kourend Woodland while world hopping in between kills, or to kill unicows instead. They will retreat from combat at low health.

label: Unicorn horn
title: Unicorn horn
lead: A unicorn horn is used to make a herblore ingredient that can be obtained as a drop from unicorns and black unicorns. It can be ground down to unicorn horn dust using a pestle and mortar. The dust can then be used as an ingredient in antipoison, super antipoison, and sanfew serum potions. It is also used alongside a cowhide to summon a Unicow in Creature Creation.

label: Unicorn horn (Underground Pass)
title: Unicorn horn (Underground Pass)
lead:
A unicorn horn is obtained by crushing a unicorn trapped in a cage during Underground Pass. When examined it indicates that this horn is withered, which distinguishes it from a standard unicorn horn dropped by a normal unicorn.

The player must first search the cage that contains the unicorn to obtain a piece of railing and then use the railing to lever a rock down onto the cage, crushing both the cage and the unicorn in the process. The player can then search the remains to obtain this horn. Later in the quest, the horn must be thrown down a well along with three paladin's badges.

label: Unicorn horn dust
title: Unicorn horn dust
lead:
Unicorn horn dust is a Herblore ingredient obtained by using a unicorn horn with a pestle and mortar or as a drop from cave bugs and cave crawlers. It can be used with a marrentill potion (unf) to make antipoison or with an irit potion (unf) to make superantipoison. It is also one of the ingredients required to turn super restores into Sanfew serums. One unicorn horn dust is used on the quest Ratcatchers.

Wesley in Nardah can crush unnoted or noted herblore secondary items for 50 coins per item.

lead:

Unknown space completely surrounds the world map and essentially serves as the edge of the game world. The unknown can also be seen around the borders of a player-owned house. It is coloured black, both on the world map and in-game.

As of 23 July 2025, the unknown is no longer present on the world map besides the edges of the world. Prior to this date, the unknown was only present in Menaphos and the western parts of Varlamore.

label: Unknown Land
title: Unknown Land
lead:
Unknown Land is a music track that is unlocked around Draynor Village. In this area, the music player will also shuffle between playing Start and Wander.

In Classic mode, the track plays in southern Draynor Village.

label: Unknown print
title: Unknown print
lead:
The unknown print is a quest item used in the Murder Mystery quest. It is lifted off of the murder weapon by using a pot of flour and a sheet of flypaper and can then be compared with similar prints lifted off of the suspects possessions in order to identify the murderer.

After the murderer is identified, the unknown print becomes the killer's print.

label: Unlisted music tracks
title: Unlisted music tracks
lead:
Unlisted music tracks are, as opposed to regular music tracks, not listed in the Music Player and as such can only be heard a limited amount of times, usually once.

They are usually played during quest cutscenes or in certain areas instead of background music. These unlisted tracks have no official name, and the music player appears as if the game is silent. They are less abundant than normal music tracks, and the known ones are listed here:

label: Unlockable content
title: Unlockable content
lead:
This page contains a list of all notable unlockable content in Old School RuneScape. The content includes access to armour, locations, and quality-of-life improvements that enhance gameplay.

The content below is not listed in any particular order and is not an exhaustive list.

label: Unlocked Ogre chest
title: Unlocked Ogre chest
lead: The unlocked ogre chest is located in Rantz's cave and is searched during the Big Chompy Bird Hunting quest. The chest becomes unlocked after the player pushes aside the rock keeping the Locked Ogre chest shut. During the quest, the player has to search the chest to obtain ogre bellows.

label: Unnamed interviewer
title: Unnamed interviewer
lead:
The interviewer is a human who made contact with several gnomes during the period where the people of Misthalin were first beginning to interact with the gnomish people. They interviewed several gnomes including Dr. Darius Gnomalus, Head of Psychology at the Gnome Institute of Knowledge as part of , a text on gnomish humour.

During the interview with Dr. Gnomalus, the interviewer was startled, recoiling in horror as the gnome suddenly exploded sending bits of gnomish flesh everywhere, only for Dr. Gnomalus to reveal the exploded dummy as a joke replica.

label: Unnamed lord
title: Unnamed lord
lead:
The lord is a farm-owner and father of Arastasia. One of his farm hands, Dentristus, was in love with his daughter.

During a harsh winter, the Wintertodt was drawn for the north devouring animals and crops, Dentristus vowed to defeat the Wintertodt, and in exchange the lord offered Arastasia's hand in marriage. The lord geared Dentristus with his best equipment, though this was not enough and Dentristus would eventually succumb to the Wintertodt's chill.

label: Unobtainable items
title: Unobtainable items
lead:
Unobtainable items are items that exist within the game's code, but cannot ever be obtained by players via normal gameplay. These items are usually found by extracting information via the game's cache. Some of these items are found in game, but cannot be placed into the inventory.

These items, like all other items, have an ID number assigned to them. Item IDs may change over certain updates, and may fill unused IDs that are considered null. Certain items used exclusively may be removed from the game and their item IDs relabeled as "Null", which are represented in the cache as pink skirts.

label: Unpowered orb
title: Unpowered orb
lead: An unpowered orb is an item used to make air orbs, water orbs, earth orbs, or fire orbs using the Magic skill.

label: unpowered symbol
title: unpowered symbol
lead:
An unpowered symbol is a symbol of Zamorak made by stringing an unstrung emblem with a ball of wool, requring 1 Crafting, yielding 4 Crafting experience.

It is made into an unholy symbol by using a completed Unholy book or Book of balance, requiring 50 Prayer, or talking to the Spirit of Scorpius after completion of the Observatory Quest which also requires claiming an unholy mould from him. He will not give the player an unholy mould if there is one already in their inventory.

label: Unranked group ironman armour
title: Unranked group ironman armour
lead:
Unranked group ironman armour is obtainable only by players who chose to be Unranked group ironmen in Ironman Mode. It can be obtained by speaking to the Group Ironman tutor on The Node or from Adam after leaving Tutorial Island, after choosing to be a Group ironman. Players may obtain a new set by speaking to either of them if they lose their set.

The armour pieces share their stats with the iron full helm, platebody and platelegs.

label: Unrestricted world
title: Unrestricted world
lead:
Unrestricted worlds, also known as tournament worlds, all-access worlds or beta worlds, refer to special servers for members that are run seperate from the main game, meaning anything a player does in these servers will not affect their progress in the normal servers. They are usually open for short periods of time.

Players have access to the Boss helper tool, allowing them to customise stats, gear, and supplies, and to instantly unlock content such quests, Achievement Diaries, and objects in the player-owned house. The tool can also be used to change spellbooks and to teleport to a variety of bosses and other locations. Previously a supply table and altar was provided instead of a boss helper tool, that also allowed for access to gear and spellbook, respectively.

label: Unstamped letter
title: Unstamped letter
lead: The unstamped letter is received from the Examiner by talking to her and choosing "Can I take an exam?" This item starts The Dig Site quest. It needs to be stamped by the Curator of the Varrock Museum, in order to continue on with the quest. If you lose this item you can get another by talking to an Examiner in the Digsite Exam Centre.

label: Unstrung symbol

lead: Unstrung symbols can be made at 16 Crafting with a silver bar and a holy mould at a furnace, granting 50 crafting experience. It can be used with a ball of wool to create an unblessed symbol. label: Untradeable items glitch
title: Untradeable items glitch
lead:
The untradeable items glitch was a major glitch that occurred on 23 March 2022. With the release of Guardians of the Rift, there were issues when dropping untradeable items. Regardless of where they were dropped, they instantly appeared for other players, enabling them to pick them up. This meant it was possible for a level 3 account to obtain an infernal cape which is otherwise impossible under ordinary circumstances.

Jagex turned the game offline about one hour after the update to perform a rollback. The game was brought back online about three hours later after the rollback finished.

Unused non-player characters are NPCs that exist within the game's code, but can not be found anywhere during normal gameplay. These exist for a variety of reasons; either they were removed from the game, replaced with other NPCs when an area was reworked, or were ultimately never made available ingame.

label: Unused shops

lead: Unused shops are Shops that, although existing in the game config, cannot be found anywhere ingame. These shops are primarily unused duplicates of existing shops, but some were previously accessible before being removed, while others were never released ingame.

label: Unusual armour
title: Unusual armour
lead:
Unusual armour is a quest item found during the Watchtower quest. Players can find it by searching the bushes surrounding the Watchtower outside the north wall of Yanille, even after the quest is complete. It serves no purpose during the quest and is merely a red herring. It cannot be worn.

The armour has a similar appearance to the original version of goblin mail, although with different colours.

label: Upcoming updates
title: Upcoming updates
lead: The following is a list of confirmed upcoming updates, derived from official Jagex sources.

label: updates
title: updates
lead:
Updates are changes that Jagex have made to Old School RuneScape. Updates occur every week on Wednesdays at around 11:30am UTC. When a large update occurs, a yellow message appears above the chat box warning players that there is a limited time, regularly 45 minutes, until all players are booted from the game as the system upgrades. To continue playing after the update, players must reload the client, or they will be provided with the message: "RuneScape has been updated! Please reload this page."

Newsposts are posts published by the development team in the Old School website talking about various game topics, including but not limited to game updates.
